title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Full stack (PHP/React)
description:
Muito prazer, somos a Zallpy!

Somos muito mais que uma empresa de tecnologia; somos uma comunidade diversa, plural e talentosa. Nosso propósito é liderar a transformação digital, com excelência e agilidade, promovendo crescimento mútuo e genuíno em relações éticas e duradouras. Flexibilidade é uma de nossas marcas registradas, atuamos em diferentes modelos e formatos de equipe, mantendo nossa cultura leve, colaborativa e integrada, proporcionando equidade de oportunidades em um espaço onde todos se sintam seguros e ouvidos.


O que você vai fazer:

  • Desenvolver soluções robustas em PHP e JavaScript no back-end;
  • Construir e consumir APIs RESTful;
  • Administrar bancos de dados MySQL/PostgreSQL com foco em performance;
  • Utilizar Docker para ambiente de desenvolvimento e deploy;
  • Trabalhar com cloud services (AWS ou Azure);
  • Aplicar boas práticas de segurança e engenharia de software;
  • Contribuir com melhorias na interface utilizando React.js e HTML/CSS;
  • Versionar código e colaborar via Git.


O que estamos buscando:

  • Experiência com React.js:
  • Experiência com PHP:
  • Experiência com gerenciamento de estado:
  • Experiência com HTML/CSS:
  • Experiência com JavaScript:
  • Experiência com RESTful APIs:
  • Experiência com MySQL/PostgreSQL:
  • Experiência com Git:
  • Experiência com Docker:
  • Experiência com AWS ou Azure:


Será um diferencial se você:

  • Ter atuado com core financeiro.


Onde você vai trabalhar:

  • Esta é uma posição para atuação 100% remota.


Modalidade de contratação:

  • CLT;
  • Cooperado;
  • PJ.


O que oferecemos:

Vale Alimentação/Refeição: Utilizamos o cartão multibenefício CAJU, em formato crédito, para proporcionar flexibilidade nas suas compras diárias.*

Plano de Saúde Unimed: Sem coparticipação ou carência para o titular. Dependentes como filhos, cônjuges ou enteados podem ser incluídos com coparticipação.*

title: Desenvolvedor FullStack Pleno - Remoto
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!

Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


(Modelo de trabalho: Remoto)

Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.

Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!

Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


(Modelo de trabalho: Home Office)


Requisitos e Qualificações:


Ensino superior completo em TI ou áreas correlatas


Sólida experiência comprovada em atividades de desenvolvimento de software (Frontend e Backend):


  • Backend
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Java 17+ e Spring Boot 3.3.x.
  • Experiência com Spring WebFlux (Programação Reativa).
  • Implementação de Spring Security com OAuth2 Client (especialmente integrações SSO como Gov.br).
  • Conhecimento em Spring Cloud, OpenFeign, JPA/Hibernate e MapStruct.
  • Manipulação de banco de dados PostgreSQL e controle de versionamento de schemas com Flyway.
  • Front end
  • Desenvolvimento em Angular (versão 14 ou superior).
  • Domínio de TypeScript (v5.8) e uso de RxJS para fluxos reativos.
  • Conhecimento avançado em HTML5 e SCSS (Sass).
  • Uso de bibliotecas como PrimeNG, FontAwesome e integração de APIs REST.
  • Qualidade e Infraestrutura
  • Testes: Escrita de testes unitários com JUnit 5, Mockito, Jasmine/Karma e uso de WireMock.
  • DevOps: Experiência com Docker, orquestração em Kubernetes (K8s) e pipelines GitLab CI/CD.
  • Ferramentas: Gestão de dependências com Maven, redução de boilerplate com Lombok e documentação com SpringDoc/Swagger.
  • Diferenciais e Conhecimentos Desejados
  • Conhecimento em Kafka Connect ou Kafka Streams.
  • Experiência com o Design System do Governo Federal (GovBR DS).
  • Familiaridade com armazenamento em nuvem via AWS SDK S3.
  • Prática em Code Review técnico focado em manutenibilidade e segurança.
  • Conhecimento em controle de versão (GIT).
  • Uso de ferramentas de IA no dia a dia (LLMs/Engenharia de Prompts).


Informações adicionais


Vale alimentação ou vale-refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini — plataforma com cursos on-line, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência médica;

title: Analytics Manager
description:
Senior Operations Data Analyst

100% Remote (Brazil-Based) | US-Based Company | Paid in USD/hour


We are hiring for a leading US-based luxury resale and eCommerce company transforming how high-end fashion is bought and sold globally.


We are looking for a Senior Operations Data Analyst with a strong analytics mindset, solid SQL expertise, and proven experience working closely with business teams. This is a high-impact role focused on operational performance, business clarity, and strategic decision-making.


About the Role


You will deliver quantitative insights to support our Operations organization, partnering closely with teams across:


  • Inventory
  • Logistics
  • Retail
  • Customer Service
  • Tech & Finance


This is a business-focused analytics role, not pure research or advanced modeling. The day-to-day work includes:


  • Explaining performance changes (“why did this move?”)
  • Turning open-ended business questions into structured analysis
  • Designing and defining KPIs
  • Measuring operational efficiency across receiving, authentication, launch, and outbound workflows
  • Translating business needs into technical solutions

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager – Technical Learning Programs


  • Location : Brazil (Remote)
  • Employment type: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) Contract | Monthly Invoicing
  • Start : ASAP | Contract through December 2026


About SureSkills

SureSkills is a global leader in technical learning and enablement, partnering with major technology organisations including Google Cloud. We design and deliver advanced cloud training programs, hands-on labs, certification pathways, and scalable technical enablement initiatives worldwide.


About the Role

This is a cross-functional, delivery-focused role supporting high-impact Google-related initiatives.


You will work closely with internal business owners across:


  • Content Development (technical workshops)
  • Technical Lab Support (hands-on learning environments)
  • Budget management and reporting


This is structured project leadership — not direct people management. The role also involves regular interaction with stakeholders at Google, requiring clear communication, structured updates, and strong alignment management.


Ideal Profile

  • 5–10 years’ experience in project management
  • Experience delivering technical, digital, or learning programs
  • Strong cross-functional coordination skills
  • Comfortable engaging enterprise stakeholders
  • Strong written and spoken English
  • Able to operate independently in a PJ contractor model


Backgrounds That Fit Well

  • Learning / Enablement Project Manager (technical programs)
  • Content Development PM for complex digital initiatives
  • Program Manager in consulting or partner ecosystems
  • Technical PM in cloud, SaaS, or infrastructure environments


What You’ll Do

Program Planning & Coordination

  • Build structured project plans and define milestones
  • Manage timelines, risks, and dependencies
  • Ensure alignment across multiple workstreams

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Coordinate lab and content development initiatives
  • Facilitate alignment meetings
  • Proactively resolve blockers

Google Stakeholder Engagement

  • Provide structured status updates
  • Clarify evolving requirements
  • Support delivery alignment between SureSkills and Google

Delivery Oversight

  • Monitor readiness of lab environments and learning assets
  • Coordinate QA and validation cycles
  • Support smooth program launch and rollout

Process Improvement

  • Contribute to scalable, repeatable delivery frameworks
  • Improve reporting, documentation, and visibility


This is a high-visibility role with direct exposure to Google stakeholders and global cloud initiatives.


If you’re a structured, delivery-driven PM who enjoys working at the intersection of technology and learning, we’d love to hear from you

title: Analista de Docagem II
description:
A pessoa será responsável pelo planejamento e acompanhamento dos projetos de docagem, incluindo avaliação técnica, gestão de inventário, uso de tecnologias e relacionamento com clientes, embarcações e terceiros. Também apoiará na elaboração de relatórios, estimativas de custos e na identificação de melhorias contínuas nos processos.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Planejar e coordenar as atividades de docagem;
  • Avaliar as especificações técnicas dos projetos de docagem;
  • Acompanhar a execução dos projetos de docagem, incluindo cumprimento de prazos, orçamento e qualidade do trabalho;
  • Desenvolver Comunicação e Relacionamento com clientes internos;
  • Preparar relatórios detalhados sobre os projetos de docagem, incluindo análises de progresso e recomendações para melhorias futuras;
  • Realizar gestão de inventário de peças, materiais e equipamentos a serem utilizados durante os projetos de docagem;
  • Desenvolver e manter procedimentos operacionais para garantir a consistência e a qualidade nos processos de docagem;
  • Implementar e supervisionar o uso de tecnologias avançadas, como sistemas de controle e monitoramento e BI;
  • Acompanhar os serviços das empresas terceirizadas;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua nos processos de docagem;
  • Estabelecer comunicação com as embarcações que irão docar;
  • Participar na elaboração de estimativas de custos para projetos de docagem.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia: Produção, Mecânica, Automação, Elétrica, Eletrônica, Mecatrônica ou Naval.
  • Experiência na área ou função similar.
  • Inglês intermediário - capacidade de ler e escrever.


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Conhecimento dos negócios e compreensão das operações na área offshore;
  • Conhecimento avançado em pacote Office, principalmente Word, Excel e Powerpoint;
  • Conhecimento em BI (mineração de dados, geração de relatórios, análise descritiva).
  • Conhecimento em Gestão de Projetos.

title: Engenheiro de Dados GCP (DBT e ETL) SR
description:
Oportunidade: Engenheiro de Dados GCP (DBT e ETL) SR


Descrição do Cargo:

Será responsável por projetar e implementar pipelines de dados robustos, utilizando DBT e tecnologias do ecossistema Google Cloud (BigQuery, Cloud Storage, LookerML, etc.). Além disso, deverá atuar com ferramentas ETL, garantindo a extração, transformação e carga de dados de forma eficiente. Será um papel essencial na estruturação de dados para análises avançadas, garantindo que os processos sejam escaláveis, seguros e otimizados.


Principais Responsabilidades:

Desenvolver e orquestrar pipelines de dados utilizando DBT , com otimização de macros e templates.

Projetar e otimizar estruturas de dados no Google Cloud (BigQuery), garantindo eficiência e desempenho em consultas SQL.

Implementar e manter processos de ETL , garantindo qualidade e governança dos dados migrados.

Utilizar Python para desenvolver scripts de automação e transformação de dados.

title: Back-End Software Engineer Sênior
description:
A GoCache desenvolveu no Brasil uma plataforma de Web Security e CDN, estrategicamente distribuída em todas as regiões do país, que entrega segurança e alta performance para cerca de 300 clientes, incluindo Ultrafarma, Kenlo, Pura Vida, Flamengo, além de instituições do mercado financeiro e do governo.


Diariamente, 20 milhões de brasileiros consomem conteúdo de algum dos 150 mil websites e aplicações que utilizam nossa plataforma, reforçando nosso compromisso em proporcionar uma experiência digital de alta qualidade.

Com foco em garantir que as empresas prosperem no ambiente digital, a GoCache oferece defesa efetiva contra ameaças cibernéticas, assegurando uma experiência online segura e fluida para a audiência de nossos clientes. Nosso compromisso vai além da proteção; buscamos também transmitir uma sensação de segurança e tranquilidade, permitindo que essas empresas se concentrem no crescimento e na inovação de seus negócios.


O desafio:

Na GoCache, você fará parte da criação e evolução de serviços backend de alta performance focados em segurança de APIs, detecção de fraudes e proteção em tempo real. Tudo o que você construir impactará diretamente a confiabilidade e inovação dos produtos que chegam aos nossos clientes.


Somos um time pequeno, colaborativo e pragmático — aqui cada pessoa tem impacto real, autonomia e liberdade para propor ideias, testar, iterar e melhorar continuamente nossos sistemas.


O que esperamos de você

Buscamos alguém desenrolado, com capacidade real de aprender rápido, navegar por contextos complexos e colaborar com outras pessoas do time. Valorizamos quem curte compartilhar conhecimento, tem boa comunicação e sabe tomar decisões técnicas com clareza.

O trabalho é PJ, com flexibilidade de horários. Não esperamos plantões ou esforço fora do horário — mas, se você quiser acompanhar alguma operação ou rotina específica por curiosidade técnica, a porta está aberta.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e evoluir arquiteturas distribuídas escaláveis e resilientes, sempre com foco em performance, segurança e simplicidade.
  • Desenvolver serviços backend (principalmente em Lua e Go) voltados à detecção de ameaças, antifraude e proteção de APIs.
  • Atuar na sustentação de sistemas críticos, investigando gargalos e propondo melhorias duradouras.
  • Elevar continuamente nossos padrões internos: testes, automações, CI/CD, observabilidade e boas práticas.
  • Apoiar e orientar pessoas do time, compartilhando conhecimento de forma clara e colaborativa.
  • Participar da definição técnica de novos produtos desde a concepção até a operação em produção.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • 7 anos de experiência com backend, incluindo atuação em sistemas distribuídos e/ou de alta performance.
  • Proficiência em programação backend (Go, Lua ou C).
  • Sólidos conhecimentos de redes e protocolos: HTTP, TLS, DNS, TCP/IP.
  • Experiência com APIs REST/GraphQL e mensageria (Kafka, Redpanda, etc.).
  • Conhecimento em bancos relacionais e não relacionais.
  • Vivência prática com Git, CI/CD, testes automatizados e observabilidade.


O que valorizamos muito

  • Boa comunicação, autonomia e capacidade de aprender e ensinar.
  • Colaborar e trocar ideias (aqui a gente resolve desafios difíceis juntos).
  • Critério técnico e visão pragmática — evitar complexidade desnecessária é uma habilidade.
  • Interesse genuíno por segurança aplicada ao desenvolvimento.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em ambientes de missão crítica, alta taxa de requisições e baixa latência (CDNs, proxies, firewalls, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de OAuth, JWT, OWASP Top 10 e práticas de segurança Web.
  • Familiaridade com containers, Kubernetes e operações orientadas a performance.
  • Contribuições em projetos open source.
  • Experiência com Prometheus, Grafana, tracing distribuído e logging estruturado.


Por que vale a pena

  • Autonomia real para propor e construir soluções.
  • Flexibilidade total — confia-se no resultado, não no relógio.
  • Zero burocracia corporativa.
  • Desafios técnicos de verdade, impacto direto no produto e espaço para crescimento rápido.


Se você quer trabalhar em um time leve, colaborativo e altamente técnico, construindo soluções que protegem a web brasileira, vamos conversar.

Benefícios

  • Auxílio home-office
  • Plano de Saúde
  • Plano Odontológico
  • Well Hub/ Gympass
  • Auxilio Terapia
  • OnHappy
  • Auxilio Alimentação

title: Back-End Software Engineer Sênior
description:
A GoCache desenvolveu no Brasil uma plataforma de Web Security e CDN, estrategicamente distribuída em todas as regiões do país, que entrega segurança e alta performance para cerca de 300 clientes, incluindo Ultrafarma, Kenlo, Pura Vida, Flamengo, além de instituições do mercado financeiro e do governo.


Diariamente, 20 milhões de brasileiros consomem conteúdo de algum dos 150 mil websites e aplicações que utilizam nossa plataforma, reforçando nosso compromisso em proporcionar uma experiência digital de alta qualidade.

Com foco em garantir que as empresas prosperem no ambiente digital, a GoCache oferece defesa efetiva contra ameaças cibernéticas, assegurando uma experiência online segura e fluida para a audiência de nossos clientes. Nosso compromisso vai além da proteção; buscamos também transmitir uma sensação de segurança e tranquilidade, permitindo que essas empresas se concentrem no crescimento e na inovação de seus negócios.


O desafio:

Na GoCache, você fará parte da criação e evolução de serviços backend de alta performance focados em segurança de APIs, detecção de fraudes e proteção em tempo real. Tudo o que você construir impactará diretamente a confiabilidade e inovação dos produtos que chegam aos nossos clientes.


Somos um time pequeno, colaborativo e pragmático — aqui cada pessoa tem impacto real, autonomia e liberdade para propor ideias, testar, iterar e melhorar continuamente nossos sistemas.


O que esperamos de você

Buscamos alguém desenrolado, com capacidade real de aprender rápido, navegar por contextos complexos e colaborar com outras pessoas do time. Valorizamos quem curte compartilhar conhecimento, tem boa comunicação e sabe tomar decisões técnicas com clareza.

O trabalho é PJ, com flexibilidade de horários. Não esperamos plantões ou esforço fora do horário — mas, se você quiser acompanhar alguma operação ou rotina específica por curiosidade técnica, a porta está aberta.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e evoluir arquiteturas distribuídas escaláveis e resilientes, sempre com foco em performance, segurança e simplicidade.
  • Desenvolver serviços backend (principalmente em Lua e Go) voltados à detecção de ameaças, antifraude e proteção de APIs.
  • Atuar na sustentação de sistemas críticos, investigando gargalos e propondo melhorias duradouras.
  • Elevar continuamente nossos padrões internos: testes, automações, CI/CD, observabilidade e boas práticas.
  • Apoiar e orientar pessoas do time, compartilhando conhecimento de forma clara e colaborativa.
  • Participar da definição técnica de novos produtos desde a concepção até a operação em produção.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • 7 anos de experiência com backend, incluindo atuação em sistemas distribuídos e/ou de alta performance.
  • Proficiência em programação backend (Go, Lua ou C).
  • Sólidos conhecimentos de redes e protocolos: HTTP, TLS, DNS, TCP/IP.
  • Experiência com APIs REST/GraphQL e mensageria (Kafka, Redpanda, etc.).
  • Conhecimento em bancos relacionais e não relacionais.
  • Vivência prática com Git, CI/CD, testes automatizados e observabilidade.


O que valorizamos muito

  • Boa comunicação, autonomia e capacidade de aprender e ensinar.
  • Colaborar e trocar ideias (aqui a gente resolve desafios difíceis juntos).
  • Critério técnico e visão pragmática — evitar complexidade desnecessária é uma habilidade.
  • Interesse genuíno por segurança aplicada ao desenvolvimento.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em ambientes de missão crítica, alta taxa de requisições e baixa latência (CDNs, proxies, firewalls, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de OAuth, JWT, OWASP Top 10 e práticas de segurança Web.
  • Familiaridade com containers, Kubernetes e operações orientadas a performance.
  • Contribuições em projetos open source.
  • Experiência com Prometheus, Grafana, tracing distribuído e logging estruturado.


Por que vale a pena

  • Autonomia real para propor e construir soluções.
  • Flexibilidade total — confia-se no resultado, não no relógio.
  • Zero burocracia corporativa.
  • Desafios técnicos de verdade, impacto direto no produto e espaço para crescimento rápido.


Se você quer trabalhar em um time leve, colaborativo e altamente técnico, construindo soluções que protegem a web brasileira, vamos conversar.

title: Senior Software Developer (React.js / Node.js)
description:

The right candidate is self-driven with a strong understanding of the software development lifecycle who wants to make an impact on technology that reaches customers and consumers globally.

The ideal candidate has strong experience working with technical onshore, offshore, and nearshore teams along with modern cloud-based platforms particularly within the AWS, Salesforce, Linode, and Heroku ecosystem, and is comfortable leading and collaborating with global cross-functional teams to support data-driven decision-making.

Our client provides innovative software solutions for automobile retailers having lead the market since 2014. With over 6,000 customers across North America, the company enhances the buying experience with cutting-edge software that eases communication and converts interest into purchases. Backed by private equity, the company's software features span website conversion, sales enablement, service offers management, retention marketing, and communication through the lenses of valuations, payments, inventory merchandising, and video.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, and maintenance of complex web applications using TypeScript, React.js, and Node.js, ensuring high-quality code standards and architectural best practices
  • Mentor junior developers through code reviews, pair programming, and technical guidance while collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable software solutions
  • Drive technical decision-making for system architecture, technology stack choices, and development processes while maintaining comprehensive documentation and testing strategies
  • Follow agile software development processes, collaborating with both onshore and offshore teams
  • Contribute to the development of cloud-based software using Node.js, React.js, TypeScript, Salesforce APEX and Lightning, PostgreSQL, AWS, MongoDB,.NET, PHP, RoR, Python, ETL/Data feeds, and Heroku
  • Continuously learn and adopt new technologies to improve product functionality


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communications skills
  • 5-10+ years of professional software development experience
  • Experience with expertise in TypeScript, React, Node.js, and modern JavaScript frameworks and libraries
  • Experience in Salesforce Lightning and SLDS, APEX, Batch, External Client Apps (Connected App), Remote setting, Salesforce Revenue Cloud with legacy applications and NetSuite
  • Experience in Business intelligence QuickSight developers, ETL process, and data extraction
  • Strong proficiency in database design and management (Salesforce Objects and triggers, MongoDB, SQL), RESTful API development, and cloud services integration with experience in CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience in leading software product development projects
  • Hands on experience leading technical teams both onshore, offshore & nearshore
  • Working under limited supervision and developing code for new business features based on functional and technical specs
  • Decomposes features for a sprint team in to tasks that can be accomplished inside of a sprint; Provides work BPLOE for tasks
  • Understands and adheres to the area's software lifecycle process
  • Communicates across and outside of team to answer questions, resolve issues, and access impacts to other teams of changes being made in their sprint team
  • Learns and utilizes new technologies as required, serves as an expert technical resource, advisor, and mentor in one or more feature sets or technologies supported by development team
  • Provides technical mentorship and work task direction to a team of developers; able to fill the Technical Owner role on an agile sprint team, holding people accountable for task delivery
  • Works with product management to groom and select Features for their area to be included in upcoming releases
  • Comfortable working within a fast-paced environment
  • Self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Knowledge of authentication systems (OAuth/OICS, OWASP security best practices including rate limiting and data encryption
  • Familiarity with AWS services, monitoring tools, and DevOps practices with the ability to troubleshoot complex production issues and implement effective solutions
  • Experience with DMS and CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Cox/VinSolutions, DealerSocket, DealerAccess), and VIN providers (e.g., DataOne, Polk, VinPower)
  • Familiarity with Google Analytics (GA4), Tag Manager (GTM), or Tag Assistant (GTA)

  • Knowledge in Business Intelligence tools, ETL, or reporting

title: Automotive Product Owner
description:
Project Description:

This role coordinates delivery and releases for an in-car accessibility product within an Android-based infotainment system, with a primary focus on meeting legal and regulatory accessibility requirements.


Core responsibilities include ensuring compliance, traceability, and correct implementation of accessibility-related changes, while driving quality improvements, defect resolution, and predictable, disciplined releases. Occasional support for new feature development is also expected.

Due to the nature of accessibility work, even small changes can have significant user and legal impact, making precision, validation, and strong execution essential. The role operates in a highly complex stakeholder environment, where stakeholders are typically hands-off during day-to-day execution but become highly involved and escalatory when issues arise. Successfully navigating these situations—through transparency, risk anticipation, sound judgment, and resolution under pressure—is a critical aspect of the role.

The role works closely with a small team of Android developers. The exact split of responsibilities will be defined once the new hire is onboarded, allowing flexibility based on individual strengths, experience, and evolving product and delivery needs.


Responsibilities:

Product & Backlog Management

• Manage and maintain the product backlog in Jira, with a primary focus on accessibility-related bug

fixes, improvements, and release work

• Support new accessibility features by preparing, refining, and tracking requirements and acceptance

criteria with stakeholder

• Clarify functional, UX, and accessibility requirements with stakeholders and engineering

• Ensure backlog items are well-defined, testable, and ready for implementation


Sprint, PI & Delivery Execution

• Plan and facilitate sprint and PI activities with the development team

• Coordinate sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and execution tracking

• Monitor progress, dependencies, and risks across sprints and PIs

• Sequence and balance work within agreed priorities and constraints to support timely delivery


Accessibility, Quality & Change Coordination

• Coordinate defect fixes, accessibility improvements, and change requests

• Assess and document impacts, dependencies, and delivery risks, especially where accessibility or

compliance may be affected

• Highlight trade-offs and potential impacts early and transparently

• Escalate complex or high-impact topics to the appropriate stakeholders

Release & Operational Ownership

• Coordinate end-to-end release activities, including readiness tracking, validation status, and

communication

• Support CI/CD, build, test, and deployment processes in collaboration with engineering

• Track release quality, regression risks, and production issues

• Coordinate verification activities on test benches and organize debugging sessions when required

• Management of test specifications (update existing test specifications if required, create test runs for

external testers, etc.)


Stakeholder Communication

• Represent the team and topic in stakeholder meetings, like calls with VW Group brands or

representatives of legal and regulatory departments

• Act as the primary coordination point for day-to-day delivery and release topics

• Communicate progress, risks, and release status clearly and consistently

• Support alignment between product, UX, engineering, and validation stakeholders


Mandatory Skills Description:

Product & Delivery Execution

• Proven experience in Product Owner, Technical Program Manager, Delivery Lead or Release Engineer roles

• Strong ability to manage end-to-end delivery in a complex, cross-functional environment

• Experience managing multiple release timelines

• Hands-on experience with backlog management, refinement, and sprint execution

• Ability to sequence and coordinate work within agreed priorities


Quality & Compliance Mindset

• Experience working with quality-critical or compliance-driven requirements

• Strong attention to detail and traceability (requirements → implementation → validation)

• Ability to manage high-risk changes where small defects can have large impact


Release & Operational Skills

• Experience coordinating software releases end to end

• Ability to track release readiness, risks, and regressions

• Comfort working with production or preproduction environments (e.g. test benches)


Tools & Ways of Working

• Experience working with distributed or nearshore teams

• Strong hands-on experience with Jira and Confluence

• Solid understanding of agile software development (Scrum, SAFe)

• Ability to operate independently with limited guidance


Stakeholder & Pressure Handling

• Proven ability to work with hands-off stakeholders who escalate under failure

• Strong communication skills: clear, calm, and structured under pressure

• Ability to anticipate issues, surface risks early, and drive resolution

• Good judgment in knowing when to act independently vs when to escalate

• Exposure to in-car UX, HMI, or accessibility topics

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including:
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels;
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institution limits and capital requirements;
  • Net-worth monitoring.
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.

title: CRO & Shopify Developer
description:
CRO & Shopify Developer

  • Full time contractor
  • £22-32k per year (depending on experience).
  • Bonus structure on performance


About PM Digital

PM Digital is The full-funnel CRO & Performance agency for 7, 8, and 9-figure DTC brands. We optimise & fix entire funnels. Our focus is increasing profitability for ecommerce brands and you are part of this through the CRO split testing and Shopify development for our client stores.


About the Role

We're looking for a CRO & Shopify Developer to join one of our pods. You'll work alongside CRO strategists, designers, and copywriters to build high-converting landing pages, implement A/B tests, and bring Figma designs to life in Shopify.

This isn't a \"fix bugs and update plugins\" role. You'll be building conversion-focused pages from scratch, implementing split tests, and directly impacting revenue for DTC brands spending serious money on paid acquisition.


What You'll Do

  • Build landing pages, PDPs, and funnel pages in Shopify based on Figma designs
  • Implement A/B and multivariate tests using Convert.com and Intelligems
  • Set up price testing, offer testing, and bundle experiments via Intelligems
  • Work within our internal app and processes to ship work on time
  • Translate designer and strategist intent into pixel-perfect, fast-loading pages
  • Ensure all builds are mobile-first, performance-optimised, and QA'd before launch
  • Collaborate daily with your pod (CRO strategist, designer, copywriter)
  • Flag technical limitations or opportunities early — don't wait until it's a problem
  • Document your work clearly so others can maintain and iterate on it


What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years Shopify development experience (themes, Liquid, custom sections)
  • ADVANCED use of AI Within your development workflow. Speed is key.
  • Strong HTML, CSS, JavaScript — you can build from scratch, not just edit templates
  • Experience turning Figma designs into production-ready Shopify pages
  • Familiarity with A/B testing platforms (Intelligems, Convert.com, or similar)
  • Understanding of page speed optimisation and Core Web Vitals
  • Comfortable working async in a remote team across time zones
  • Strong written communication, you'll be working with non-developers daily
  • Attention to detail, sloppy work doesn't ship
  • Strong AI Use case to speed up time to delivery


What Success Looks Like

  • Pages go live on time, match the design, and perform well
  • Tests are implemented correctly the first time — no re-work loops
  • You proactively flag issues and suggest better solutions
  • Your pod trusts you to execute without hand-holding


You'll Thrive Here If You:

  • Want ownership, not tickets
  • Care about the outcome (revenue), not just the output (code)
  • Move fast and communicate clearly
  • Take pride in clean, maintainable work
  • Want to grow with a high-performance team


You Won't Thrive Here If You:

  • Need constant direction or detailed specs for every task
  • See QA as someone else's problem
  • Struggle with direct feedback
  • Don't hit deadlines


Details

  • Remote (European time zone based)
  • Full-time contractor
  • Salary based on experience - £22-34k BOE


How to Apply

Send a short note on why this role fits you, plus:

  • Link to 2-3 Shopify websites or experiences you've built (landing pages or custom work preferred)
  • Brief explanation of a test you implemented and how it performed (if applicable)


Fill in this form after the job role, you will get all your information here.


DON'T USE AI FOR QUESTIONS AND ANSWERS -

title: Analista financeiro pleno
description:
Sua nova empresa


Faça parte de uma companhia nacional de grande porte no setor agro, atuante em revenda e distribuição de insumos agropecuários em diversos estados do Brasil. A organização vive um momento de expansão, fortalecimento da governança e evolução de sua estrutura financeira, com forte interface com operações comerciais e cadeia produtiva do agronegócio.


Sua nova posição


Como Analista financeiro pleno , você terá papel essencial na sustentação operacional e financeira da companhia, atuando no processamento, controle e acompanhamento das operações de antecipação de recebíveis, carteiras em garantia e rotinas do contas a receber. Será responsável por garantir a acuracidade dos dados, apoiar interações com instituições financeiras, organizar informações críticas e contribuir diretamente para a eficiência do fluxo de caixa.


O reporte será à gestão Financeira/Tesouraria.


Suas principais responsabilidades



  • Preparar arquivos e dossiês de títulos para antecipação;
  • Conferir relatórios de bancos e FIDCs, acompanhando títulos aceitos e rejeitados;
  • Filtrar títulos conforme critérios de elegibilidade e conciliar carteiras antecipadas;
  • Atualizar controles e relatórios de recebíveis vinculados a operações financeiras;
  • Auxiliar na organização de informações e documentação das carteiras em garantia;
  • Realizar baixas de títulos, conciliar recebimentos e extrair dados de múltiplas plataformas;
  • Emitir boletos, enviar a clientes e conduzir tratativas com lojas, jurídico e controladoria;
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais (fluxo de recebíveis, aging, projeções e posições financeiras).


Perfil desejado


  • Excel avançado — mandatório (haverá teste);
  • Conhecimento em Matemática algébrica básica — (haverá teste);
  • Conhecimento de Matemática financeira - Diferencial;
  • Experiência com conciliações bancárias e carteiras de recebíveis;
  • Capacidade de medir impactos contábeis do contas a receber — diferencial;
  • Conhecimento em ERP Protheus ou Sankhya (preferência para Protheus).


Requisitos obrigatórios


  • Graduação em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;

title: Back-End Software Engineer Sênior
description:
A GoCache desenvolveu no Brasil uma plataforma de Web Security e CDN, estrategicamente distribuída em todas as regiões do país, que entrega segurança e alta performance para cerca de 300 clientes, incluindo Ultrafarma, Kenlo, Pura Vida, Flamengo, além de instituições do mercado financeiro e do governo.


Diariamente, 20 milhões de brasileiros consomem conteúdo de algum dos 150 mil websites e aplicações que utilizam nossa plataforma, reforçando nosso compromisso em proporcionar uma experiência digital de alta qualidade.

Com foco em garantir que as empresas prosperem no ambiente digital, a GoCache oferece defesa efetiva contra ameaças cibernéticas, assegurando uma experiência online segura e fluida para a audiência de nossos clientes. Nosso compromisso vai além da proteção; buscamos também transmitir uma sensação de segurança e tranquilidade, permitindo que essas empresas se concentrem no crescimento e na inovação de seus negócios.


O desafio:

Na GoCache, você fará parte da criação e evolução de serviços backend de alta performance focados em segurança de APIs, detecção de fraudes e proteção em tempo real. Tudo o que você construir impactará diretamente a confiabilidade e inovação dos produtos que chegam aos nossos clientes.


Somos um time pequeno, colaborativo e pragmático — aqui cada pessoa tem impacto real, autonomia e liberdade para propor ideias, testar, iterar e melhorar continuamente nossos sistemas.


O que esperamos de você

Buscamos alguém desenrolado, com capacidade real de aprender rápido, navegar por contextos complexos e colaborar com outras pessoas do time. Valorizamos quem curte compartilhar conhecimento, tem boa comunicação e sabe tomar decisões técnicas com clareza.

O trabalho é PJ, com flexibilidade de horários. Não esperamos plantões ou esforço fora do horário — mas, se você quiser acompanhar alguma operação ou rotina específica por curiosidade técnica, a porta está aberta.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e evoluir arquiteturas distribuídas escaláveis e resilientes, sempre com foco em performance, segurança e simplicidade.
  • Desenvolver serviços backend (principalmente em Lua e Go) voltados à detecção de ameaças, antifraude e proteção de APIs.
  • Atuar na sustentação de sistemas críticos, investigando gargalos e propondo melhorias duradouras.
  • Elevar continuamente nossos padrões internos: testes, automações, CI/CD, observabilidade e boas práticas.
  • Apoiar e orientar pessoas do time, compartilhando conhecimento de forma clara e colaborativa.
  • Participar da definição técnica de novos produtos desde a concepção até a operação em produção.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • 7 anos de experiência com backend, incluindo atuação em sistemas distribuídos e/ou de alta performance.
  • Proficiência em programação backend (Go, Lua ou C).
  • Sólidos conhecimentos de redes e protocolos: HTTP, TLS, DNS, TCP/IP.
  • Experiência com APIs REST/GraphQL e mensageria (Kafka, Redpanda, etc.).
  • Conhecimento em bancos relacionais e não relacionais.
  • Vivência prática com Git, CI/CD, testes automatizados e observabilidade.


O que valorizamos muito

  • Boa comunicação, autonomia e capacidade de aprender e ensinar.
  • Colaborar e trocar ideias (aqui a gente resolve desafios difíceis juntos).
  • Critério técnico e visão pragmática — evitar complexidade desnecessária é uma habilidade.
  • Interesse genuíno por segurança aplicada ao desenvolvimento.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em ambientes de missão crítica, alta taxa de requisições e baixa latência (CDNs, proxies, firewalls, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de OAuth, JWT, OWASP Top 10 e práticas de segurança Web.
  • Familiaridade com containers, Kubernetes e operações orientadas a performance.
  • Contribuições em projetos open source.
  • Experiência com Prometheus, Grafana, tracing distribuído e logging estruturado.


Por que vale a pena

  • Autonomia real para propor e construir soluções.
  • Flexibilidade total — confia-se no resultado, não no relógio.
  • Zero burocracia corporativa.
  • Desafios técnicos de verdade, impacto direto no produto e espaço para crescimento rápido.


Se você quer trabalhar em um time leve, colaborativo e altamente técnico, construindo soluções que protegem a web brasileira, vamos conversar.

title: Automotive Product Owner
description:
Project Description:

This role coordinates delivery and releases for an in-car accessibility product within an Android-based infotainment system, with a primary focus on meeting legal and regulatory accessibility requirements.


Core responsibilities include ensuring compliance, traceability, and correct implementation of accessibility-related changes, while driving quality improvements, defect resolution, and predictable, disciplined releases. Occasional support for new feature development is also expected.

Due to the nature of accessibility work, even small changes can have significant user and legal impact, making precision, validation, and strong execution essential. The role operates in a highly complex stakeholder environment, where stakeholders are typically hands-off during day-to-day execution but become highly involved and escalatory when issues arise. Successfully navigating these situations—through transparency, risk anticipation, sound judgment, and resolution under pressure—is a critical aspect of the role.

The role works closely with a small team of Android developers. The exact split of responsibilities will be defined once the new hire is onboarded, allowing flexibility based on individual strengths, experience, and evolving product and delivery needs.


Responsibilities:

Product & Backlog Management

• Manage and maintain the product backlog in Jira, with a primary focus on accessibility-related bug

fixes, improvements, and release work

• Support new accessibility features by preparing, refining, and tracking requirements and acceptance

criteria with stakeholder

• Clarify functional, UX, and accessibility requirements with stakeholders and engineering

• Ensure backlog items are well-defined, testable, and ready for implementation


Sprint, PI & Delivery Execution

• Plan and facilitate sprint and PI activities with the development team

• Coordinate sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and execution tracking

• Monitor progress, dependencies, and risks across sprints and PIs

• Sequence and balance work within agreed priorities and constraints to support timely delivery


Accessibility, Quality & Change Coordination

• Coordinate defect fixes, accessibility improvements, and change requests

• Assess and document impacts, dependencies, and delivery risks, especially where accessibility or

compliance may be affected

• Highlight trade-offs and potential impacts early and transparently

• Escalate complex or high-impact topics to the appropriate stakeholders

Release & Operational Ownership

• Coordinate end-to-end release activities, including readiness tracking, validation status, and

communication

• Support CI/CD, build, test, and deployment processes in collaboration with engineering

• Track release quality, regression risks, and production issues

• Coordinate verification activities on test benches and organize debugging sessions when required

• Management of test specifications (update existing test specifications if required, create test runs for

external testers, etc.)


Stakeholder Communication

• Represent the team and topic in stakeholder meetings, like calls with VW Group brands or

representatives of legal and regulatory departments

• Act as the primary coordination point for day-to-day delivery and release topics

• Communicate progress, risks, and release status clearly and consistently

• Support alignment between product, UX, engineering, and validation stakeholders


Mandatory Skills Description:

Product & Delivery Execution

• Proven experience in Product Owner, Technical Program Manager, Delivery Lead or Release Engineer roles

• Strong ability to manage end-to-end delivery in a complex, cross-functional environment

• Experience managing multiple release timelines

• Hands-on experience with backlog management, refinement, and sprint execution

• Ability to sequence and coordinate work within agreed priorities


Quality & Compliance Mindset

• Experience working with quality-critical or compliance-driven requirements

• Strong attention to detail and traceability (requirements → implementation → validation)

• Ability to manage high-risk changes where small defects can have large impact


Release & Operational Skills

• Experience coordinating software releases end to end

• Ability to track release readiness, risks, and regressions

• Comfort working with production or preproduction environments (e.g. test benches)


Tools & Ways of Working

• Experience working with distributed or nearshore teams

• Strong hands-on experience with Jira and Confluence

• Solid understanding of agile software development (Scrum, SAFe)

• Ability to operate independently with limited guidance


Stakeholder & Pressure Handling

• Proven ability to work with hands-off stakeholders who escalate under failure

• Strong communication skills: clear, calm, and structured under pressure

• Ability to anticipate issues, surface risks early, and drive resolution

• Good judgment in knowing when to act independently vs when to escalate


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

Domain & Platform Experience

• Experience with automotive software or infotainment systems

• Familiarity with Android Automotive or embedded platforms

• Exposure to in-car UX, HMI, or accessibility topics


Accessibility & UX Awareness

• Experience with accessibility, usability, or inclusive design

• Familiarity with accessibility standards or legal requirements (any domain)


Advanced Release / Engineering Exposure

• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, build, test, and deployment processes

• Release engineering or DevOps collaboration experience

• Experience supporting stabilization, bugfix-heavy, or late-stage products

• Experience coordinating cross-team dependencies


Environment & Collaboration

• Comfort operating across time zones

• Experience in environments with high expectations and low tolerance for failure


Tools & Ways of Working

• Experience in requirements & test case

management in CodeBeamer

title: Consultor(a) Água, Efluentes e Resíduos
description:
O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.


Sobre a Arauco Brasil


No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.



Sobre a Função


Desafios:

Oferecer suporte técnico e estratégico para a gestão dos recursos hídricos da fábrica de celulose Arauco, garantindo a eficiência da captação e do tratamento de água, bem como o tratamento e descarte dos efluentes industriais, otimizando custos e minimizando desperdício. Atendimento aos indicadores de rotina (KPI) e apoiando time técnico na realização de testes industriais. Experiência em planos de gerenciamento de resíduos, mitigação de impactos ambientais e remediação emergencial (Suporte às áreas com paradas e geração de residuos) e interface com contratos (Gestão indireta de time de movimentação de reíduos). Promovendo práticasseguras, sustentáveis que unam responsabilidade ambiental, inovação e eficiência operacional, com visão estratégica para projetos.



Principais Atividades:

title: AWS Platform Engineer
description:
About You

You are an experienced Platform Engineer who enjoys building internal platforms that empower development teams. You are motivated by improving developer experience through self-service tooling, automation, and scalable infrastructure. You thrive in environments where you can pioneer new practices, lead technical initiatives, and design solutions that will become foundational across the organization.


You are comfortable working hands-on in AWS, collaborating with distributed teams, and translating platform concepts into practical, maintainable solutions.


  • This position is offered under a contractor model for an initial period of 6 months , with the possibility of extension.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 6+ years of experience designing and implementing architectures and services on AWS.
  • Proven experience as a Platform Engineer, ideally building internal platforms or self-service tools for developers.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform and Terraform Cloud for Infrastructure as Code.
  • Proven experience using GitHub and GitHub Actions for CI/CD workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS ECS and related container services.
  • Experience provisioning sandbox or ephemeral environments for development or testing.
  • Solid understanding of Platform Engineering as a discipline and its impact on developer productivity.
  • Experience leading or pioneering new tools, workflows, or technical practices within an organization.
  • Strong English communication skills to collaborate with distributed teams and US-based stakeholders.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted development tools and workflows (nice to have).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, write, and maintain reusable Terraform modules to power AWS infrastructure provisioning.
  • Design and implement a self-service portal that allows developers to request sandbox ephemeral environments on AWS.
  • Research, plan, and document the implementation of the self-service portal, ensuring long-term maintainability and supportability.
  • Define workflows and automation that improve developer experience and infrastructure scalability.
  • Champion Platform Engineering practices across the organization as an early adopter and technical leader.
  • Collaborate with engineering and DevOps teams to ensure platform solutions align with development needs and standards.
  • Continuously improve platform reliability, usability, and operational efficiency.


Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Strong experience with AWS platform services (ECS and container services).
  • Experience building self-service platforms or ephemeral environments.
  • Conversational English (B2+).


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Project Manager with logistics experience - Remote
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • At least ten years of professional experience in successfully executing and managing complex IT projects (including Logistic integration Projects);
  • Experience with 3PL Integrations;
  • Strong experience in project management methodologies (classic and agile);
  • Organized, result-oriented work style characterized by a high degree of initiative;
  • PMP certification;
  • Written and oral fluency in English (+B2) - mandatory.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: remote.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.

title: Senior-Principal .NET Engineer
description:
Project Description:

Small team of expert level engineers to deliver changes across multiple services related to arbitrage.


Primary Stack: .NET, Kafka, MSSQL, Azure


Responsibilities:

- Collaborate with Portfolio managers and external teams

- Derive requirements and match it with architecture solutions

- Develop, test and deploy applications

- L3 support of end users and business


Mandatory Skills Description:

• Independent mindset, passion for technology, and an appetite for taking ownership, learning new technologies, and building innovative products.

• Minimum 5 years of development experience in financial services or technology industries.

• Full lifecycle experience including requirements gathering, implementation, testing, release, and support.

• Strong technical and development skills in cross-platform environment, preferably in C#

• Experience in Cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP) experience involving stateless and serverless solutions, event-driven architecture and cost optimization

• Experience in IaC development with Terraform/OpenTofu/Bicep/Pulumi

• Experience in container technologies (e.g., Docker, Podman) and container orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker Swarm).

• Experience with SQL development, preferably in a SQL Server environment.

• Exposure to multi-threaded programming concepts.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Strong team player.

• Bachelor's degree in computer science or engineering.

• .NET Core and Entity Framework Core.


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

• Knowledge of arbitrage strategies

• Experience with various financial products such as equities, derivatives, fixed income, etc., and related terminology.

• Experience working with market data (e.g. Bloomberg APIs, etc.).

• Experience with containerization and orchestrators.

• Experience with Test Driven Development.

• Experience with profiling and performance tuning techniques throughout the entire stack.

• Experience with NoSQL databases, including document databases and graph databases.

• Angular experience.


Languages:

English: C1 Advanced

title: Fullstack Java Engineer
description:
Who are we?

Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Europe - Romania, Poland, and Ukraine, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.


Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 200 people over the past three years and plans to continue growing.


This role is for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer who can independently drive complex features from idea to production. You’ll work in a cross-functional Scrum team and be trusted to make sound technical decisions, even when requirements are incomplete.

This is not a ticket-driven role. It’s about ownership, judgment, and building software that holds up in production.


What you’ll own

  • End-to-end feature delivery: Drive features across frontend and backend — from technical discovery to release.
  • System design & quality: Design and evolve solutions for complex workflows and data flows, with a focus on reliability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Production mindset: Debug issues across environments, contribute to incident resolution, and build observability into systems from day one.
  • Engineering excellence: Uphold and evolve standards around code quality, reviews, and deployments. Mentor peers through thoughtful feedback.
  • Collaboration: Partner closely with Product, Design, Platform, and Support. Participate actively in Scrum ceremonies.

Must have:

  • Strong experience with a modern Java-based web stack
  • Hands-on experience with React.js and Typescript
  • Experience building and owning full-stack web applications
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms , preferably AWS
  • Strong communication skills and an ownership-driven mindset
  • Ability to work independently while staying aligned with the team

Nice to have

  • Kotlin and Dart
  • Experience with relational databases or data-heavy systems

title: Implementation Manager
description:
About the job


Sphere Pay is looking for a full-time Implementation Manager based in Miami or Brazil. As an Implementation Manager at Sphere Pay, you will be the critical bridge between our sales/GTM team and our product organization, ensuring customers can successfully integrate and leverage our API-first payment infrastructure. The work you do directly supports our customers' ability to move money with us; you will regularly have an outsized impact on Sphere Pay's customer success and product evolution.

Key Responsibilities:


Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Partner with the Head of BD on discovery calls to gather customer technical requirements. Assess requirements against our current capabilities, architect tailored solutions, and clearly communicate any gaps to our product team. You will translate complex customer needs into actionable product feedback.


Integration Lifecycle Management: Own the full integration lifecycle from initial discovery call through final go-live. This includes creating development guides, providing hands-on support during implementation, and ensuring customers have a clear path to successful integration with our API.


Customer Technical Support: Handle integration requests from the sales team post-discovery. Guide external developers on how to integrate our API, explaining not just the how but the why behind integration decisions.


Product Feedback Loop: Serve as the voice of the customer to our product team. Translate specific customer requests into product requirements and advocate for features that will improve the customer experience and expand our capabilities.


Customer Relationship Management (CRM): Build long-term partnerships with clients acting as the primary point of contact for technical inquiries and strategic planning. Track, report, and update necessary internal systems related to client implementations.


Qualifications:


  • Fluency in English, Portuguese Required - Spanish business level fluency is nice to have
  • 3+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions architecture, or API Implementation
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience working with APIs and guiding developers through integrations.
  • Proven experience writing technical documentation, API docs, and integration guides.
  • Experience within payments and/or fintech required.
  • Crypto/Web3 is a plus but not required.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Self-starter comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Fully Remote - Based in Miami or Brazil (preferred).


Sphere Pay is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds and experiences to apply.

Sphere Pay is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

title: Automotive Product Owner
description:
Project Description:

This role coordinates delivery and releases for an in-car accessibility product within an Android-based infotainment system, with a primary focus on meeting legal and regulatory accessibility requirements.


Core responsibilities include ensuring compliance, traceability, and correct implementation of accessibility-related changes, while driving quality improvements, defect resolution, and predictable, disciplined releases. Occasional support for new feature development is also expected.

Due to the nature of accessibility work, even small changes can have significant user and legal impact, making precision, validation, and strong execution essential. The role operates in a highly complex stakeholder environment, where stakeholders are typically hands-off during day-to-day execution but become highly involved and escalatory when issues arise. Successfully navigating these situations—through transparency, risk anticipation, sound judgment, and resolution under pressure—is a critical aspect of the role.

The role works closely with a small team of Android developers. The exact split of responsibilities will be defined once the new hire is onboarded, allowing flexibility based on individual strengths, experience, and evolving product and delivery needs.


Responsibilities:

Product & Backlog Management

• Manage and maintain the product backlog in Jira, with a primary focus on accessibility-related bug

fixes, improvements, and release work

• Support new accessibility features by preparing, refining, and tracking requirements and acceptance

criteria with stakeholder

• Clarify functional, UX, and accessibility requirements with stakeholders and engineering

• Ensure backlog items are well-defined, testable, and ready for implementation


Sprint, PI & Delivery Execution

• Plan and facilitate sprint and PI activities with the development team

• Coordinate sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and execution tracking

• Monitor progress, dependencies, and risks across sprints and PIs

• Sequence and balance work within agreed priorities and constraints to support timely delivery


Accessibility, Quality & Change Coordination

• Coordinate defect fixes, accessibility improvements, and change requests

• Assess and document impacts, dependencies, and delivery risks, especially where accessibility or

compliance may be affected

• Highlight trade-offs and potential impacts early and transparently

• Escalate complex or high-impact topics to the appropriate stakeholders

Release & Operational Ownership

• Coordinate end-to-end release activities, including readiness tracking, validation status, and

communication

• Support CI/CD, build, test, and deployment processes in collaboration with engineering

• Track release quality, regression risks, and production issues

• Coordinate verification activities on test benches and organize debugging sessions when required

• Management of test specifications (update existing test specifications if required, create test runs for

external testers, etc.)


Stakeholder Communication

• Represent the team and topic in stakeholder meetings, like calls with VW Group brands or

representatives of legal and regulatory departments

• Act as the primary coordination point for day-to-day delivery and release topics

• Communicate progress, risks, and release status clearly and consistently

• Support alignment between product, UX, engineering, and validation stakeholders


Mandatory Skills Description:

Product & Delivery Execution

• Proven experience in Product Owner, Technical Program Manager, Delivery Lead or Release Engineer roles

• Strong ability to manage end-to-end delivery in a complex, cross-functional environment

• Experience managing multiple release timelines

• Hands-on experience with backlog management, refinement, and sprint execution

• Ability to sequence and coordinate work within agreed priorities


Quality & Compliance Mindset

• Experience working with quality-critical or compliance-driven requirements

• Strong attention to detail and traceability (requirements → implementation → validation)

• Ability to manage high-risk changes where small defects can have large impact


Release & Operational Skills

• Experience coordinating software releases end to end

• Ability to track release readiness, risks, and regressions

• Comfort working with production or preproduction environments (e.g. test benches)


Tools & Ways of Working

• Experience working with distributed or nearshore teams

• Strong hands-on experience with Jira and Confluence

• Solid understanding of agile software development (Scrum, SAFe)

• Ability to operate independently with limited guidance


Stakeholder & Pressure Handling

• Proven ability to work with hands-off stakeholders who escalate under failure

• Strong communication skills: clear, calm, and structured under pressure

• Ability to anticipate issues, surface risks early, and drive resolution

• Good judgment in knowing when to act independently vs when to escalate


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

Domain & Platform Experience

• Experience with automotive software or infotainment systems

• Familiarity with Android Automotive or embedded platforms

• Exposure to in-car UX, HMI, or accessibility topics


Accessibility & UX Awareness

• Experience with accessibility, usability, or inclusive design

• Familiarity with accessibility standards or legal requirements (any domain)


Advanced Release / Engineering Exposure

• Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, build, test, and deployment processes

• Release engineering or DevOps collaboration experience

• Experience supporting stabilization, bugfix-heavy, or late-stage products

• Experience coordinating cross-team dependencies


Environment & Collaboration

• Comfort operating across time zones

• Experience in environments with high expectations and low tolerance for failure


Tools & Ways of Working

• Experience in requirements & test case

management in CodeBeamer

title: Gerente de contas | Mato Grosso/MT
description:
Unidade de Negócio: Sem Parar Empresas


Modelo de trabalho: Presencial


Missão da área: Conectar empresas a soluções inovadoras de mobilidade e gestão, impulsionando a eficiência e a produtividade por meio do portfólio Sem Parar Empresas. Nosso compromisso é oferecer um atendimento consultivo e estratégico, garantindo a melhor experiência para os clientes e contribuindo para o crescimento sustentável do negócio.


Objetivos do cargo que você irá atuar: Como Gerentes de contas você será responsável por vender o portfólio Sem Parar Empresas, oferecendo soluções de abastecimento de acordo com a necessidade de cada cliente. Além disso, será responsável por inserir informações no Salesforce, construir o funil de vendas, abrir novos mercados e buscar novas oportunidades. Também deverá gerir o pipeline, manter um fluxo de vendas consistente e acompanhar as implantações, com o objetivo de atingir as metas de receita inicial.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar contato ágil com os leads recebidos por meio dos canais disponíveis (telefone, e-mail e WhatsApp), atuando na qualificação e conversão de oportunidades.
  • Conduzir reuniões presenciais e virtuais com prospects e clientes para levantamento de necessidades, entendimento do projeto e apresentação de soluções personalizadas.
  • Registrar todas as interações comerciais (ligações, e-mails e reuniões) no Salesforce, garantindo organização e rastreabilidade das informações.
  • Criar e gerenciar oportunidades no Salesforce, elaborar propostas comerciais, realizar follow-ups estratégicos e atuar ativamente no fechamento das negociações.
  • Acompanhar o processo de implantação, assegurando o início da operação conforme contratado e a satisfação do cliente.
  • Gerenciar o funil de vendas, mantendo previsões realistas e controle das etapas das oportunidades.
  • Garantir a conclusão das vendas por meio do acompanhamento remoto ou presencial dos clientes, monitorando o fluxo de utilização para impulsionar o crescimento e o faturamento da carteira.
  • Atuar de forma integrada com as áreas internas, especialmente com o time de pós-vendas, garantindo alinhamento e excelência na jornada do cliente.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior cursando ou completo.
  • Experiência com vendas consultivas e gestão de funil de vendas.
  • CNH categoria B válida.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.
  • Vivência em vendas B2B, preferencialmente com meios de pagamento.


Informações adicionais

Fique por dentro do que te oferecemos:

  • Vale-alimentação ou Vale-refeição — você escolhe uma das duas modalidades;
  • Veículo corporativo;
  • Auxílio combustível;
  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Telemedicina — Disponível 24h por dia, todos os dias da semana;
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass);
  • PLR (Participação nos Lucros e Resultados, de acordo com a política vigente);
  • Day off de aniversário — Folga no seu aniversário e também no aniversário da empresa;

title: Senior SAP Consultant
description:
Senior SAP Fieldglass Consultant (Remote, Brazil)


We are looking for a Senior SAP Fieldglass Consultant to join a global project, working 100 percent remotely from Brazil . This role is for someone with real hands on experience in SAP Fieldglass implementations , not generic SAP consulting.


If you have worked deeply with Fieldglass CWM and SOW , understand Source to Pay , and are comfortable working directly with clients, this role is for you.


What You Will Do

  • Work on SAP Fieldglass implementation and rollout projects
  • Configure and support Contingent Workforce Management (CWM) and Statement of Work (SOW) processes
  • Collaborate with procurement, HR, finance, and IT stakeholders
  • Support integrations between SAP Fieldglass and SAP Ariba, SAP S 4HANA, or SAP ECC
  • Analyze business requirements and translate them into Fieldglass configuration
  • Identify risks early and propose clear mitigation actions
  • Support testing, defect resolution, and UAT activities using JIRA
  • Ensure high quality delivery with strong focus on customer satisfaction

Mandatory Experience

  • 6 or more years of hands on experience with SAP Fieldglass
  • Proven experience in Fieldglass implementation or rollout projects
  • Strong configuration experience in CWM and SOW
  • Solid understanding of Source to Pay processes
  • Experience integrating Fieldglass with SAP Ariba and SAP S 4HANA or SAP ECC
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
  • Strong communication skills and confidence working with stakeholders

Nice to Have

  • Experience with SAP SuccessFactors
  • Previous work in global or multi country projects
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills

Work Setup

  • Location: Brazil
  • Work model: 100 percent remote
  • Client interview required
  • English is mandatory for daily communication

Important

  • Resumes must be submitted in English
  • This role requires real SAP Fieldglass project experience
  • Candidates without Fieldglass hands on experience will not be considered
