title: Tech Lead Salesforce Developer
description:
Tech Lead Salesforce Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Executivo de Território
description:
Estamos em busca de um profissional dinâmico e motivado para integrar nossa equipe comercial. Se você é apaixonado por desafios, tem atitude de dono e busca uma carreira de sucesso, essa oportunidade é para você!


Responsabilidades:

  • Visitar entre 8 a 12 Farmácias de pequeno e médio porte da região;
  • Planejar e identificar as oportunidades de vendas, verificar, executar MPDV, dentro das rotinas do PEX (Programa de Excelência) na base de PDVs;
  • Atingir as metas de vendas estabelecidas;
  • Participar das reuniões diárias – matinal e fechamento de vendas on-line, de segunda à sexta.
  • Participar de treinamentos e eventos para atualização e desenvolvimento profissional;


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Excelente comunicação e capacidade de negociação;
  • Capacidade analítica verificar e atuar nas oportunidades;
  • Disciplina para cumprimento de rotina;
  • Disposição para trabalhos externos e viagens estaduais;
  • Carteira de motorista B;
  • Experiência Comercial Bens de consumo, Bebidas, Sorvete, Canal conveniência, setor de Adquirência (desejável);
  • Proatividade, atitude de dono e foco em resultados;
  • Desejável: Cursando Ensino Superior (Cursos prioritários: Engenharias, Economia, Física, Estatísticas, Matemática, Adm,)
  • Residir na zona norte do Rio de Janeiro.


Motivos para trabalhar na Legrand:

  • A Legrand oferece uma carreira acelerada com oportunidades de aprendizado e desenvolvimento real, em uma cultura de crescimento e meritocracia;

A Legrand hoje:

  • Empresa com mais de 100 SKUs, sendo 25 produtos líderes ou vice-líderes de mercado;
  • Faturamento anual superior a R$1 bilhão, com destaque para o produto Expec, que gera R$300 milhões por ano;

História recente:

  • Nos últimos três anos e meio, a Legrand dobrou de tamanho, aumentou seu market share e subiu duas posições no ranking, agora sendo a terceira maior;
  • Quintuplicou o número de colaboradores e foi certificada no ranking GTPW de melhores empresas para trabalhar nos últimos dois anos;
  • Novo lema “Viva a Vida”, focado em criar marcas amadas pelos consumidores.

Estamos em busca de um profissional dinâmico e motivado para integrar nossa equipe comercial. Se você é apaixonado por desafios, tem atitude de dono e busca uma carreira de sucesso, essa oportunidade é para você!


Responsabilidades:

  • Visitar entre 8 a 12 Farmácias de pequeno e médio porte da região;
  • Planejar e identificar as oportunidades de vendas, verificar, executar MPDV, dentro das rotinas do PEX (Programa de Excelência) na base de PDVs;
  • Atingir as metas de vendas estabelecidas;
  • Participar das reuniões diárias – matinal e fechamento de vendas on-line, de segunda à sexta.
  • Participar de treinamentos e eventos para atualização e desenvolvimento profissional;


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Excelente comunicação e capacidade de negociação;
  • Capacidade analítica verificar e atuar nas oportunidades;
  • Disciplina para cumprimento de rotina;
  • Disposição para trabalhos externos e viagens estaduais;
  • Carteira de motorista B;
  • Experiência Comercial Bens de consumo, Bebidas, Sorvete, Canal conveniência, setor de Adquirência (desejável);
  • Proatividade, atitude de dono e foco em resultados;
  • Desejável: Cursando Ensino Superior (Cursos prioritários: Engenharias, Economia, Física, Estatísticas, Matemática, Adm,)
  • Residir na zona norte do Rio de Janeiro.


Motivos para trabalhar na Legrand:

  • A Legrand oferece uma carreira acelerada com oportunidades de aprendizado e desenvolvimento real, em uma cultura de crescimento e meritocracia;

A Legrand hoje:

  • Empresa com mais de 100 SKUs, sendo 25 produtos líderes ou vice-líderes de mercado;
  • Faturamento anual superior a R$1 bilhão, com destaque para o produto Expec, que gera R$300 milhões por ano;

História recente:

  • Nos últimos três anos e meio, a Legrand dobrou de tamanho, aumentou seu market share e subiu duas posições no ranking, agora sendo a terceira maior;
  • Quintuplicou o número de colaboradores e foi certificada no ranking GTPW de melhores empresas para trabalhar nos últimos dois anos;
  • Novo lema “Viva a Vida”, focado em criar marcas amadas pelos consumidores.

title: Engenheiro de Dados
description:
Transforme Dados em Estratégia e Inovação!


Você é apaixonado(a) por transformar dados em ativos estratégicos para os negócios? Tem domínio de Azure, Databricks e busca desafios em projetos de grande escala? Então essa oportunidade é para você!

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior para liderar o desenvolvimento e a sustentação de pipelines modernos e eficientes em ambiente cloud. Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar com tecnologias de ponta, colaborar com times multidisciplinares e impactar diretamente decisões estratégicas por meio de dados de qualidade.


Suas responsabilidades incluirão:


Desenhar, implementar e otimizar arquiteturas e processos de engenharia de dados, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e eficiência.

Desenvolver e implementar soluções de engenharia de dados em ambiente Azure (Data Factory, Synapse

Analytics, Databricks, Data Lake, SQL Database).

Estruturar pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT) de alta performance e confiabilidade.

Atuar na modelagem de dados, integração de sistemas e governança da informação.

Garantir boas práticas de performance, segurança e escalabilidade.

Colaborar com times multidisciplinares e stakeholders internacionais.

Participar de reuniões e apresentações em inglês avançado.


Idioma: Inglês avançado

title: Analista Ciência de Dados Júnior
description:
Falar da MRV&CO é dizer muito mais do que ser os títulos que recebemos durante nossa história de 46 anos. Ser a maior construtora da América Latina nos orgulha muito. Mas não só isso! Queremos mais e ir além! Somos uma Companhia inovadora e incansável na busca de soluções de moradia. Somos a MRV&CO e, em breve, desejamos ser reconhecidos como plataforma habitacional, nas diferentes frentes e possibilidades. Nos desafiamos e acreditamos na nossa força. E é importante que se evidencie: a força da MRV&CO está em nossa gente. Uma Gente com G maiúsculo, engajada, protagonista, transformadora.

Vem #SERSangueVerde com a gente!

title: Growth Business Development (Fresh Graduates | Brazil)
description:
About BingX


  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018
  • With 40 million registered users worldwide
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC
  • First official crypto exchange partner of Scuderia Ferrari HP
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified
  • List over 1,000 spot trading pairs
  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko
  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users


Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 40 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Part-time | REMOTE


Responsibilities


  • Formulate business development plans, assist the team in completing the introduction, negotiation, cooperation, and signing of business cooperation projects
  • Contact, negotiate, and close profitable deals with potential KOLs
  • Support KOL and design special campaigns to increase KOL trading volume
  • Build partnerships with KOLs or crypto projects, and promote cooperation with each other
  • Conduct research to identify new markets and customer needs
  • Build long-term relationships with new and existing KOL/clients


Requirements


  • Open to fresh graduates or part-time Business Development
  • Highly motivated, proactive, and passionate about achieving results
  • A good understanding of crypto markets is a plus
  • Proficiency in English and Portuguese is essential


Working at BingX


  • Join an international and diversified team
  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefits

title: SharePoint Developer (SPFx & Power Platform)
description:
About the job


Project Duration: 3 to 6 months

Engagement Type: Contract / Project-Based


We are seeking an experienced SharePoint Developer with strong expertise in SharePoint Online, SPFx, Nintex, and the Power Platform. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing customized SharePoint solutions, workflows, and business applications while supporting migrations and system integrations.

This role requires strong development skills in ASP.NET, C#, JavaScript, Web APIs, and SQL Server, along with experience in automation and modern SharePoint frameworks.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain solutions in SharePoint Online and On-Premises environments
  • Develop custom solutions using SPFx (SharePoint Framework), React, and TypeScript
  • Build and customize SharePoint Web Parts, Extensions, and Forms
  • Develop and maintain Nintex Workflows and Forms
  • Create and manage workflows using Power Automate
  • Build business applications using Power Apps (Canvas and Model-Driven)
  • Develop and consume RESTful Web APIs
  • Integrate SharePoint with third-party systems and Microsoft services (Graph API, Azure AD)
  • Perform SharePoint migrations (On-Prem to Online, File Share to SharePoint)
  • Develop backend components using ASP.NET, C#, and .NET Framework/Core
  • Write and optimize SQL Server queries, stored procedures, and views
  • Automate administrative tasks using PowerShell (PnP PowerShell)
  • Participate in solution architecture, requirement gathering, and technical documentation
  • Ensure compliance with governance, security, and best practices
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 3+ years of experience in SharePoint development
  • Strong experience with:
  • SharePoint Online & SharePoint Server
  • SPFx Framework
  • Nintex (Workflows & Forms)
  • Power Automate & Power Apps
  • ASP.NET / C#
  • JavaScript, HTML, CSS
  • SQL Server
  • Experience developing and consuming Web APIs
  • Experience with SharePoint migrations (ShareGate)
  • Strong knowledge of SharePoint security and permissions model
  • Experience with PowerShell scripting
  • Familiarity with Azure AD authentication and Microsoft Graph API


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Azure services (Azure Functions, Logic Apps)
  • Experience with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines
  • Knowledge of React and modern front-end frameworks
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
  • Microsoft certifications (SharePoint, Power Platform, Azure)


Technical Skills Summary

  • SharePoint Online & On-Prem
  • SPFx (React/TypeScript)
  • Nintex Workflows
  • Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate)
  • ASP.NET / C#
  • Web API Development
  • JavaScript / HTML / CSS
  • SQL Server
  • PowerShell
  • SharePoint Migrations

title: Senior Azure Cloud Architect
description:
About You

You are a senior-level Azure Cloud Architect who enjoys building secure, scalable, and automated cloud platforms. You take ownership of architectural decisions and are comfortable translating business and platform requirements into repeatable Azure foundations. You value clean design, governance, and automation, and you collaborate closely with application, DevOps, security, and infrastructure teams.


You thrive in complex enterprise environments, communicate technical concepts clearly, and act as a technical reference for Azure architecture, networking, security, and platform automation.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience architecting and operating solutions in Microsoft Azure.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Proven experience implementing Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) and Azure Landing Zones.
  • Strong hands-on expertise with Terraform, including modular design and remote state management.
  • Experience designing enterprise Azure architectures, including multi-subscription environments.
  • Strong experience with Azure DevOps, including YAML pipelines and CI/CD governance.
  • Solid experience designing hub-and-spoke network architectures and hybrid connectivity.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  • Strong understanding of cloud security, governance, and enterprise-scale architecture.
  • Experience implementing Azure security controls, RBAC, policies, and compliance standards.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and clear technical communication.
  • Azure certifications (AZ-305, AZ-400, AZ-104, AZ-204) and/or Terraform certification (nice to have).
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement Azure tenant architectures aligned with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework and Azure Landing Zone best practices.
  • Define and manage management group hierarchies, subscription strategies, and environment separation.
  • Establish standardized patterns for identity, networking, security, governance, and logging.
  • Build and maintain Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code and integrate it into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Design and maintain multi-stage Azure DevOps pipelines for infrastructure and platform automation.
  • Architect and support enterprise networking, including hub-and-spoke topologies and hybrid connectivity.
  • Support containerized platforms using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  • Implement and enforce Azure security, governance, and compliance controls.
  • Collaborate with application, DevOps, security, and infrastructure teams on platform adoption.
  • Provide technical guidance and architectural direction to engineering teams.
  • Continuously improve platform reliability, scalability, and operational excellence.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience designing and operating Azure cloud architectures
  • Proven experience implementing Azure Landing Zones and Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF)
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform (Infrastructure as Code)
  • Experience with Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines (YAML)
  • Advanced English proficiency.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Stablecoin Operations Manager
description:
EUROPROP® Trading is a proprietary digital asset trading firm operating across global cryptocurrency markets. We combine institutional-grade risk controls, capital efficiency strategies, and high-performance infrastructure to manage and scale digital asset operations.


As stablecoins play a critical role in liquidity management, settlement flows, and cross-exchange capital deployment, we are expanding our operational leadership team. We are seeking a highly skilled Stablecoin Operations Manager to oversee stablecoin liquidity management, treasury flows, on-chain transfers, and counterparty coordination.

This is a strategic and operational role at the core of our capital infrastructure.


Key Responsibilities
  • Oversee daily stablecoin treasury operations across multiple exchanges and blockchain networks.
  • Manage minting, redemption, transfers, and liquidity balancing of major stablecoins (USDT, USDC, DAI, etc.).
  • Monitor on-chain transactions, gas optimization, settlement timing, and network congestion risks.
  • Coordinate capital allocation between trading desks, custodians, and exchange accounts.
  • Implement operational risk controls, reconciliation procedures, and reporting systems.
  • Manage counterparty exposure and settlement processes with liquidity providers.
  • Ensure accurate internal reporting of stablecoin balances and transactional flows.


Requirements
  • Proven experience working with stablecoins in a trading, exchange, fintech, or crypto-native environment.
  • Strong understanding of blockchain networks (Ethereum, Tron, BSC, etc.) and on-chain settlement mechanics.
  • Experience managing large-scale treasury flows and liquidity operations.
  • High attention to detail and operational risk awareness.
  • Ability to operate independently in a fully remote structure.
  • Strong analytical and process-management skills.
  • Professional proficiency in English.


What We Offer
  • Annual salary: BRL 420,000–480,000, plus performance-based bonus structure.
  • Fully remote role within Brazil.
  • Direct involvement in managing large-scale digital asset liquidity operations.
  • Institutional-grade infrastructure and multi-exchange connectivity.
  • High-responsibility environment with measurable operational impact.
  • Long-term growth opportunity within a rapidly expanding digital asset trading firm.

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including:
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels;
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institution limits and capital requirements;
  • Net-worth monitoring.
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

description:

  • Desenvolver, evoluir e orquestrar pipelines de dados escaláveis, confiáveis e monitoráveis;
  • Atuar na construção e sustentação de arquiteturas de dados em ambientes de alta volumetria e alta criticidade;
  • Projetar e implementar modelos dimensionais (tabelas fato, dimensões, datamarts e métricas);
  • Realizar transformação e enriquecimento de dados para consumo analítico;
  • Garantir qualidade de dados (data quality), governança e consistência das métricas;
  • Implementar boas práticas de observabilidade e monitoramento de pipelines;
  • Realizar tuning e otimização de queries SQL e estruturas de armazenamento;
  • Trabalhar com arquitetura de Data Lake e Data Warehouse;
  • Apoiar tecnicamente o time na definição de padrões, boas práticas e evolução arquitetural;
  • Garantir qualidade de código, versionamento e esteiras de CI/CD;
  • Atuar em parceria com áreas de negócio para entendimento de métricas, regras de negócio e construção de soluções analíticas.




Requisitos e qualificações


  • Domínio avançado de SQL (DQL, DML, DDL, DCL, DTL);
  • Experiência com modelagem dimensional (Star Schema, Snowflake, fato, dimensões, surrogate keys);
  • Experiência com arquitetura de Data Warehouse e Data Lake;
  • Experiência com criação, orquestração e monitoramento de pipelines de dados (Apache Airflow);
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL e Oracle);
  • Experiência com AWS Redshift;
  • Conhecimento em práticas de Data Quality e observabilidade;
  • Experiência com Git e esteiras de CI/CD (Jenkins);

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager – Technical Learning Programs


  • Location : Brazil (Remote)
  • Employment type: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) Contract | Monthly Invoicing
  • Start : ASAP | Contract through December 2026


About SureSkills

SureSkills is a global leader in technical learning and enablement, partnering with major technology organisations including Google Cloud. We design and deliver advanced cloud training programs, hands-on labs, certification pathways, and scalable technical enablement initiatives worldwide.


About the Role

This is a cross-functional, delivery-focused role supporting high-impact Google-related initiatives.


You will work closely with internal business owners across:


  • Content Development (technical workshops)
  • Technical Lab Support (hands-on learning environments)
  • Budget management and reporting


This is structured project leadership — not direct people management. The role also involves regular interaction with stakeholders at Google, requiring clear communication, structured updates, and strong alignment management.


Ideal Profile

  • 5–10 years’ experience in project management
  • Experience delivering technical, digital, or learning programs
  • Strong cross-functional coordination skills
  • Comfortable engaging enterprise stakeholders
  • Strong written and spoken English
  • Able to operate independently in a PJ contractor model


Backgrounds That Fit Well

  • Learning / Enablement Project Manager (technical programs)
  • Content Development PM for complex digital initiatives
  • Program Manager in consulting or partner ecosystems
  • Technical PM in cloud, SaaS, or infrastructure environments


What You’ll Do

Program Planning & Coordination

  • Build structured project plans and define milestones
  • Manage timelines, risks, and dependencies
  • Ensure alignment across multiple workstreams

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Coordinate lab and content development initiatives
  • Facilitate alignment meetings
  • Proactively resolve blockers

Google Stakeholder Engagement

  • Provide structured status updates
  • Clarify evolving requirements
  • Support delivery alignment between SureSkills and Google

Delivery Oversight

  • Monitor readiness of lab environments and learning assets
  • Coordinate QA and validation cycles
  • Support smooth program launch and rollout

Process Improvement

  • Contribute to scalable, repeatable delivery frameworks
  • Improve reporting, documentation, and visibility


This is a high-visibility role with direct exposure to Google stakeholders and global cloud initiatives.


If you’re a structured, delivery-driven PM who enjoys working at the intersection of technology and learning, we’d love to hear from you

title: Mainframe Automation Engineer (zOS) - HOME OFFICE
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer (zOS Automation and CA OPS/MVS) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.


Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .


All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).


We are seeking an experienced Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer to lead the migration and optimization of mainframe automation solutions. This role focuses on transitioning from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and from CA Automation Point to IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM) . The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring operational efficiency, system availability, and seamless automation processes within a complex z/OS environment.


You will collaborate closely with the Automation team to implement policy-based automation solutions, reduce administrative overhead, and enhance system responsiveness. This position does not impact application development but will significantly influence automation strategies and operations.


Job responsibilities :

  • Lead migration projects from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and CA Automation Point to IBM SAIOM.
  • Configure and implement IBM Systems Automation solutions, including policy-based automation for z/OS environments.
  • Develop and maintain automation rules, REXX execs, and System Automation Policy Database (PDB) configurations.
  • Provide installation and configuration assistance for IBM automation products.
  • Collaborate with operations teams to optimize system startup, shutdown, and recovery processes.
  • Ensure high availability and efficiency of critical systems through proactive automation strategies.
  • Document processes, configurations, and migration steps; deliver clear communication to stakeholders.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve automation-related issues in production environments.


Key skills :

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in a mainframe operations environment in an operational, service, consultancy, or support role.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience.
  • TSO and ISPF: Proficient in using these tools for system management.
  • JCL: Strong skills in Job Control Language.
  • REXX Programming: Ability to write and maintain REXX scripts.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Working knowledge required.
  • Migration Experience: Proven track record in z/OS automation migration projects.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experience in implementing and using this product.


Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of other IBM Z software, including system operation, configuration, and automation.
  • Familiarity with z/OS system startup and shutdown processes.
  • Experience with SMP/E for software installation and maintenance.
  • Understanding of competing automation products in the mainframe space.
  • Expertise in fully automated system configurations on IBM Z.

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

title: Cientista de Dados (IA)
description:
Estamos em busca de um Cientista de Dados com atuação na implementação de soluções com IA , sensoriamento remoto, geoprocessamento e análises espaciais.


Formação:

  • Graduado/Especializações em Matemática, Ciências Exatas, da Terra, Sensoriamento Remoto, Engenharia Cartográfica, Tecnologia da Informação e afins.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Linguagem de programação com foco em manipulação de dados (Python);
  • Conceitos de Estatística e Geoestatística;
  • Conhecimento em SQL/NoSQL;
  • Experiência em algoritmos de Machine Learning e Deep Learning;
  • Experiência em assistentes e agentes de IA integrados a modelos LLM;
  • Manipulação de dados espaço-temporais (geográficos com componente temporal);
  • Desejável conhecimento em sistemas de informação geográfica, sensoriamento remoto, geoprocessamento e análises e


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Realizar tarefas regulares como: entendimento do problema de negócio, requisitos da solução, exploração de dados, treinamento e execução de modelos de Deep Learning e Machine Learning, análises estatísticas e geoestatísticas, configuração de fluxos de automação de processamento dos dados, confecção de relatórios e painéis de apresentação de informações;
  • Compreender as necessidades do negócio, fornecer insights acionáveis e recomendações com base nas análises e traduzi-las em proposição de solução;
  • Utilizar plenamente seus conhecimentos e habilidade para a extração de dados de fontes de diversas origens, ferramentas e formatos, incluindo dados espaço-temporais;
  • Aplicar técnicas de reconhecimento de padrões, incluindo, mas não se limitando à visão computacional, modelos de redes neurais convolucionais (CNN), modelos de linguagem para processamento de linguagem natural (NLP), assistentes e agentes de IA integrados a Large Language Models (LLM) e análise de dados e análise preditiva (ML);
  • Aplicar técnicas de sensoriamento remoto para definição de soluções de mapeamento de uso e cobertura do solo através da visão computacional para interpretação de imagens de satélite e/ou radar;
  • Testar e validar soluções de ciência de dados para garantir sua eficácia, qualidade e atendimento aos requisitos;
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências e avanços na área de ciência de dados;
  • Participar e promover discussões técnicas e processos de ideação / inovação. Contribuindo para um ambiente de confiança, liberdade e troca, propício à criatividade;
  • Colaborar com a equipe de Data Science na construção de soluções.


Por que escolher a Geosistemas?

Saúde e Bem-Estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico - Sul América.
  • ✅ Seguro de Vida e Acidentes Pessoais.

title: Estagiário de Assuntos Regulatórios
description:
A Sherwin-Williams é uma multinacional líder global no setor de revestimentos e proteção, com presença em mais de 120 países. Com mais de 80 anos de atuação no Brasil, temos o compromisso de oferecer soluções inovadoras e de alta qualidade em tintas, atendendo às mais diversas necessidades dos nossos clientes.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Estagiário(a) para integrar nossa equipe de Assuntos Regulatórios Packaging, contribuindo com projetos estratégicos e colaborando para a criação de novas ferramentas e produtos. Se você é curioso(a), gosta de inovação e quer fazer parte de uma empresa que valoriza o desenvolvimento profissional, essa oportunidade é para você!


Requisitos:

  • Estar cursando o 2º ou 3º ano de Química ou Engenharia Química;
  • Conhecimentos em informática (Pacote Office);
  • Inglês intermediário (desejável);
  • Perfil proativo, com vontade de aprender e se desenvolver.


Principais Atividades:

  • Avaliação de fórmulas para a preparação de Ficha com Dados de Segurança (português, espanhol e inglês) para os produtos de linha no sistema DATASUL.
  • Avaliação de fórmulas para a preparação de Ficha com Dados de Segurança (português, espanhol e inglês) para as fórmulas experimentais e Chile – procedimento 100% manual.
  • Atualização do SharePoint de Regulatórios Global e LATAM.
  • Avaliação de substâncias ou matérias-primas presentes nas formulações dos produtos através do sistema DATASUL.
  • Atualização de informações no sistema DATASUL que possam impactar as Ficha com Dados de Segurança, conforme necessário.
  • Verificação da publicação de novas regulamentações: Anvisa e Mercosul, consultando o Diário Oficial.
  • Preparação dos documentos, preparo e envio de amostras (chapas de aço inoxidável) para laboratórios terceirizados para testes de migração.
  • Fornecer dados do DATASUL de acordo com a substância em uso e seus impactos do ponto de vista regulatório.
  • Atualizar as planilhas para controle de dados nas plataformas global e local - cartas e declarações, testes, Ficha com Dados de Segurança).
  • Preparar um projeto especial alinhado às necessidades da equipe regulatória da América Latina.
  • Levantamento de Dados Mensais (cartas e declarações e Ficha com Dados de Segurança).



Bolsa-Auxílio e Benefícios:

Bolsa-Auxílio: de acordo com o ano em curso na faculdade;

Benefícios: Assistência Médica e Odontológica, Seguro de Vida, Refeição no Local, Vale Transporte ou Ônibus Fretado.

You will be responsible for translating complex user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant, and effective design solutions. This role requires a strong focus on core user experience, user flows, and wireframing, in addition to high-quality visual user interface (UI) execution.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • User Experience (UX) Strategy and Design
  • Lead the design process from initial concept and user research through to final implementation and iteration, focusing on complex user flows, information architecture, and system design.
  • Develop and refine wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to communicate design intent and test hypotheses with users and stakeholders.
  • Conduct usability testing, analyze user data, and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement of the product experience.
  • Design and integrate Agentic AI experiences into product flows, ensuring a seamless, trustworthy, and effective interaction between the user and the AI system.
  • User Interface (UI) Design and Visual Execution
  • Create polished, high-fidelity visual designs and detailed design specifications that adhere to brand guidelines and accessibility standards.
  • Maintain and contribute to our existing Design System, ensuring consistency, scalability, and efficiency across all product touchpoints.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all product outputs, focusing on design principles that enhance clarity and drive user adoption.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
  • Collaboration and Implementation
  • Partner closely with Product Managers to define product strategy and requirements, ensuring design solutions align with business objectives and technical constraints.
  • Collaborate with front-end engineers to ensure accurate design implementation and a seamless, high-quality user experience post-launch.
  • Participate in agile development processes, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and design critiques.

  • UX/UI Acumen: Exceptional ability to translate strategic product goals into logical user flows and visually compelling, intuitive user interfaces, evidenced by a strong public portfolio of work on consumer-facing web products.
  • Technical Design Proficiency: Expertise in current design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) for creating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and specifications.

  • English Proficiency: Advanced spoken English level (B2–C1 or higher).

  • Advanced Proficiency in UX Design: Deep expertise in the full lifecycle of UX design, including user research, wireframing, journey mapping, and developing interactive prototypes that demonstrate complex user flows.
  • Expert UI/Visual Design Experience: Strong, hands-on experience in high-fidelity visual design, typography, color theory, and creating/maintaining design systems for web products.
  • Consumer Web Focus: Demonstrated ability to design and launch successful consumer-facing products on the web.

  • AI/ML Design: Experience designing user experiences for AI/ML-powered features or familiarity with the principles of Agentic AI.
  • Familiarity with motion design and animation principles to enhance user interactions.
  • Proficiency with front-end code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript frameworks) to facilitate better collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in Design, HCI, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on Product Design (UX/UI) for consumer-facing web applications, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.

title: Product Designer (UX/UI, Consumer Web Focus)
description:
For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Product Designer to own the end-to-end user experience for our Carnegie Audiences suite of products (careerexplorer.com and supplemental products), including the integration and design of new Agentic AI interactions. You will be responsible for translating complex user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant, and effective design solutions. This role requires a strong focus on core user experience, user flows, and wireframing, in addition to high-quality visual user interface (UI) execution.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • User Experience (UX) Strategy and Design
  • Lead the design process from initial concept and user research through to final implementation and iteration, focusing on complex user flows, information architecture, and system design.
  • Develop and refine wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to communicate design intent and test hypotheses with users and stakeholders.
  • Conduct usability testing, analyze user data, and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement of the product experience.
  • Design and integrate Agentic AI experiences into product flows, ensuring a seamless, trustworthy, and effective interaction between the user and the AI system.
  • User Interface (UI) Design and Visual Execution
  • Create polished, high-fidelity visual designs and detailed design specifications that adhere to brand guidelines and accessibility standards.
  • Maintain and contribute to our existing Design System, ensuring consistency, scalability, and efficiency across all product touchpoints.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all product outputs, focusing on design principles that enhance clarity and drive user adoption.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
  • Collaboration and Implementation
  • Partner closely with Product Managers to define product strategy and requirements, ensuring design solutions align with business objectives and technical constraints.
  • Collaborate with front-end engineers to ensure accurate design implementation and a seamless, high-quality user experience post-launch.
  • Participate in agile development processes, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and design critiques.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • UX/UI Acumen: Exceptional ability to translate strategic product goals into logical user flows and visually compelling, intuitive user interfaces, evidenced by a strong public portfolio of work on consumer-facing web products.
  • Technical Design Proficiency: Expertise in current design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) for creating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and specifications.
  • Design Ownership and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a design portfolio autonomously, proactively identify design opportunities, and take ownership of the product’s end-to-end user experience.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively navigate complex design challenges and continuously seek elegant solutions that balance user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively present design rationale to non-technical stakeholders and facilitate productive design critiques.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced spoken English level (B2–C1 or higher).


Requirements:

  • Advanced Proficiency in UX Design: Deep expertise in the full lifecycle of UX design, including user research, wireframing, journey mapping, and developing interactive prototypes that demonstrate complex user flows.
  • Expert UI/Visual Design Experience: Strong, hands-on experience in high-fidelity visual design, typography, color theory, and creating/maintaining design systems for web products.
  • Consumer Web Focus: Demonstrated ability to design and launch successful consumer-facing products on the web.
  • Portfolio: Mandatory submission of a portfolio (e.g., personal website, Dribbble, GitHub) that clearly demonstrates a focus on design thinking, user flows, and high-end aesthetic execution for consumer web applications.


Nice-to-haves:

  • AI/ML Design: Experience designing user experiences for AI/ML-powered features or familiarity with the principles of Agentic AI.
  • Familiarity with motion design and animation principles to enhance user interactions.
  • Proficiency with front-end code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript frameworks) to facilitate better collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in Design, HCI, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on Product Design (UX/UI) for consumer-facing web applications, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

title: Programa de Estágio 2026.01
description:
Programa de Estágio 2026.1


Local de trabalho:

Av. Engenheiro Luís Carlos Berrini, 1253, São Paulo/SP - Híbrido ou Presencial

A MetLife

Somos uma das principais seguradoras do mundo!

Na MetLife, você será parte de um time que trabalha com muita paixão, colaboração e acolhimento. Aqui, temos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo, onde todos podem ser quem são!

Contamos com grupos internos de diversidade, equidade e inclusão, e já recebemos diversos prêmios e reconhecimentos por nossos trabalhos em prol da sociedade, sustentabilidade e diversidade.

No Brasil desde 1999, com mais de 150 anos de história como uma das principais empresas de serviços financeiros do mundo, estamos presentes em mais de 40 países, atendendo mais de 100 milhões de clientes.

Quer participar dessa oportunidade? Estamos te esperando!

O Programa

No Programa de estágio MetLife 2025 você terá oportunidade de atuar em colaboração com uma equipe dentro de uma das áreas de uma seguradora multinacional, e o seu desenvolvimento será acompanhado por treinamentos, mentorias e experiências de responsabilidade social que proporcionam insights valiosos para seu futuro pessoal e profissional.

Você pode fazer parte de área como RH, Contabilidade, Previdência, Marketing, Operações, Comercial, Pricing, entre outras.

O que buscamos?

Procuramos pessoas que sejam colaborativas, proativas, comunicativas, comprometidas, que tenham senso de urgência e busquem desenvolvimento contínuo. Além disso, proporcionamos um ambiente propício para aprender e testar corajosamente novas ideias.

O que precisa saber ou ter?

Obrigatórias:

  • Superior cursando em Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis, Ciências Atuariais, Psicologia, Marketing, Publicidade e Propaganda, Engenharias, Estatística e/ou correlatas.
  • Conhecimentos no Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point);
  • Disponibilidade de atuação híbrida (3 vezes por semana) ou presencial por 6h em horário comercial na região da Berrini
  • Formação a partir de Junho/2028.

Diferenciais:

  • Inglês Intermediário/Avançado
  • Habilidades com Python, Power BI, SQL

Benefícios:

  • Bolsa auxílio competitiva
  • Auxílio transporte (VT)
  • Vale-refeição (VR)
  • Plano de saúde
  • Plano odontológico
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Gympass
  • 13º salário

Na MetLife, estamos liderando a transformação global de um setor definido há tempos pela nossa empresa. Com uma única missão, mas diferentes perspectivas, estamos comprometidos em fazer a diferença na vida de nossos clientes.

A MetLife orgulha-se de ser um empregador que oferece oportunidades iguais, empenhado em atrair, reter e maximizar o desempenho de uma força de trabalho diversificada e inclusiva. A política da MetLife é assegurar igualdade de oportunidades de emprego sem qualquer discriminação ou assédio baseado em raça, cor, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero, idade, invalidez, nacionalidade ou estado civil, cidadania ou por qualquer motivo.

title: Desenvolvedor de Mobile
description:

Empresa: Atman


FAIXA SALARIAL

R$ 4.500 a R$ 9.000 (CLT)

Enquadramento conforme avaliação técnica.


SOBRE A VAGA

Vaga para desenvolvimento de aplicativos mobile voltados a produtos digitais, com consumo de APIs complexas, dados em tempo real, integração com hardware e dispositivos, uso de mapas e geolocalização e atuação em aplicações operacionais e críticas.


Os aplicativos suportam configuração de dispositivos, comunicação contínua com backend e operação em ambientes que exigem estabilidade, desempenho e confiabilidade em produção.


RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicativos mobile Android e iOS
  • Implementação de aplicações em React Native
  • Integração com APIs REST e comunicação em tempo real (WebSockets)
  • Integração com hardware e dispositivos
  • Implementação de funcionalidades com mapas e geolocalização
  • Atuação em apps operacionais e críticos
  • Garantia de estabilidade, performance e confiabilidade
  • Gerenciamento de estado, ciclo de vida e comunicação assíncrona
  • Integração com times de backend, frontend web, hardware e produto


STACK E CONHECIMENTOS TÉCNICOS (OBRIGATÓRIOS)

  • React Native
  • TypeScript e JavaScript
  • Consumo de APIs REST
  • Comunicação em tempo real (WebSockets)
  • Integração com hardware / dispositivos
  • Uso de mapas e geolocalização
  • Conceitos de performance mobile
  • Versionamento com Git


DIFERENCIAIS

  • Espanhol ou Italiano a nível de conversação serão considerados um grande diferencial.
  • Experiência com Android nativo (Kotlin)
  • Experiência com apps publicados em loja
  • Vivência com aplicações operacionais ou críticas
  • Integração com dispositivos físicos


REQUISITOS

  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos com desenvolvimento mobile
  • Inglês intermediário a avançado
  • Graduação em Engenharias, Ciência da Computação, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas


PERFIL TÉCNICO ESPERADO

  • Perfil analítico
  • Capacidade técnica elevada
  • Facilidade para resolver problemas complexos
  • Atenção a impacto em produção, estabilidade e desempenho


REGIME DE CONTRATAÇÃO E BENEFÍCIOS

Regime de contratação: CLT Presencial

Jornada de trabalho: Segunda a sexta-feira, das 08h às 17h

Benefícios:

  • Seguro de vida
  • Plano de carreira estruturado

title: Pessoa Cientista de Dados - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas negras
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de cientistas seniores você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidade.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (coleta e tratamento de dados, análise exploratória de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, produtização de modelos)
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas

O que nós estamos procurando:

Ter cursado um curso de graduação em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina, matemática, ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.

  • Desejável um primeiro conhecimento em estatística e programação (Python/R).
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes, você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor
  • Colaboração : o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact
  • Empreendedorismo : você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: Analista de Pesquisa – SUM (Single Usability Metric) SR
description:
Código da vaga: 57654


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.



  • Ei, profissional de UX Research - venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?

Noções de UX Research e testes de usabilidade

Experiência com prototipação (Figma)

Familiaridade com Maze ou ferramentas de teste remoto

Conforto com planilhas e análise de dados (Excel, Google Sheets ou similares)

Conhecimento de métricas de usabilidade (eficiência, eficácia, satisfação)

Experiência com o modelo SUM

Experiência em projetos de produtos digitais em escala

Vivência em ambientes ágeis


Responsabilidades:

Apoiar a preparação e execução de pesquisas de usabilidade no modelo SUM

Revisar e validar protótipos, fluxos e tarefas antes dos testes

Configurar testes no Maze (ou ferramentas similares)

Acompanhar testes em campo e apoiar ajustes necessários

Extrair, limpar e organizar dados dos testes

Apoiar o cálculo das métricas de usabilidade e do SUM

Contribuir na análise dos resultados e identificação de insights

Apoiar a construção de relatórios e recomendações para os times de produto

Seguir padrões, templates e boas práticas do SUM, garantindo consistência.


Modelo 100% home office

CLT pela BRQ + Pacote de benefícios


- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: Business Development Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Development Managerto join our team. As a rapidly growing company, we are looking for talented individuals committed to helping us achieve our goals. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of driven individuals dedicated to making a difference in the industry.



Responsibilities

  • Proactively recruit and develop effective local partnerships with merchandise partners, manufacturers, and brands. Focus on categories selections to increase overall value, in alignment with business and customer needs.
  • Assist merchandise partners in establishing themselves on the platform and their growth.Guide merchandise partners in developing comprehensive plans including market positioning, product planning, brand marketing, and operational strategies.
  • Propose innovative ideas based on the current status of the categories, as well as create and implement projects through resource integration and merchant guidance.
  • Conduct industry analysis reports, explore potential customer needs through data analysis, and adjust strategies accordingly based on market trends.


Required skills / Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of operational experience, including but not limited to experience in brand management or platform operations.
  • Extensive connections and relationships with local seller and vendor networks is a plus.
  • Strong data analysis skills, able to analyze industry trends and project management through data, and summarize conclusions.
  • Possesses market exploration and marketing innovation capabilities, capable of guiding overall merchant marketing plans.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, self-motivation, ability to think strategically and adapt quickly to changes.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage logistics during high-demand periods.


Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.


Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer – Distributed Systems

Duration: 3 months initially (strong extension potential)

Day Rate: £250 (B2B Contractor - Approx. $340)

Location: Remote (UK / EU Time Zones Preferred)


We’re seeking an experienced Data Engineer to help build and scale a distributed event processing system handling - 1 billion events per day within a fast-growing advertising analytics company.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and optimise distributed data processing systems
  • Build high-throughput event pipelines in Go and/or Python
  • Work within a large Data Build Tools instance transforming data in a warehouse
  • Improve system performance and scalability
  • Collaborate closely with the Technical Lead and small engineering team
  • Contribute to architectural decisions for a new distributed system


Required Experience:

  • Strong experience building distributed systems
  • Proven experience processing high-volume event data
  • Production-level Go and/or Python experience
  • Strong SQL skills (data warehousing context)
  • Experience working with Data Build Tools
  • Ability to work independently and deliver value quickly
  • Experience in advertising, analytics, or large-scale data platforms is advantageous

title: Senior Python Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Python Engineer with strong backend expertise and solid experience in API integrations to join our team. This role will focus on building and maintaining integrations with Shopify Fulfillment Services, designing robust event-driven systems, and ensuring high reliability across distributed components.


If you are passionate about scalable architectures, clean code, and solving complex integration challenges, this opportunity is for you.


Key Responsibilities


  • Build internal system adapters and perform complex data mapping
  • Implement webhook processing and event-driven workflows
  • Design robust error handling, retry strategies, and idempotent processes
  • Write comprehensive unit and integration tests
  • Collaborate with the team on API design, architecture decisions, and technical improvements
  • Debug and troubleshoot production issues with a proactive mindset


✅ Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of professional experience with Python development
  • Strong experience building and consuming REST APIs
  • Solid knowledge of webhook architecture and event handling
  • Experience with OAuth authentication flows
  • Familiarity with e-commerce platforms (Shopify experience is highly preferred)
  • Experience with asynchronous processing and message queues
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills
  • Fluent English communication skills

title: Technical Support Engineer - Level 3 (VMWare)
description:
About the Company

Park Place Technologies is a global data center and networking optimization firm. Powered by the world’s largest on-the-ground engineering team, a robust group of advanced engineers and our fully staffed, 24x7x365 Enterprise Operations Center, we offer a robust portfolio of IT solutions to optimize networking and data center Uptime and performance. As the industry leader, our 2500 Park Place Associates provide support to 21,000+ customers in more than 180+ countries. We are proud to service 90% of Fortune 500 companies and 40% of Forbes 100 clients. Our company’s strength and success are a credit to our Associates, and Park Place Life is how we communicate and deliver our culture internally. We have been awarded as a NorthCoast 99 “Best Workplace” winner for 14 consecutive years in recognition of our employee commitment. Park Place Life is about collaboration, responsiveness, diversity, and integrity, and represents everything that makes our company great and our culture unique.


Technical Support Engineer Level 3 – Wintel/VMWare


The Technical Support Engineer L3 is responsible for proactively responding to the technical challenges and requirements for customers within the Managed Services environments. The Managed Services department is primarily focused on delivering the whole solutions lifecycle, including; Presales, design, implementing, supporting, maintaining and decommissioning data centre solutions to ensure the continuity of business operations for all customers. This role is expected to work with other members of the managed services and technical teams in implementing and supporting solutions for new and existing customers.


What you’ll be doing:

· Deliver support solutions for Managed Services customers in line with industry best practice to deliver continual service improvement over the whole service lifecycle.

· Work closely with WINTEL Team Lead to ensure new customers are migrated with seamless handover / transition from onboarding into the steady state managed service environment.

· Implementing new and refreshed managed service solutions for hosted customer environments.

· Dynamically monitor, manage and improve managed service environments. Identifying and resolving root cause of issues and ensuring continual service availability.

· Strive for continual service improvement based on a desire to become a world class managed service provider.

· Contribute proactively to new service development.

· Deliver a high-performance culture in the team with a focus on teamwork, service excellence and ownership for resolving customer issues.

· Guarantee operational procedures and practices are well defined, documented and consistently applied.

· Ensure quality, up-to-date documentation exists for all service arrangements.

· Other duties assigned


What we’re looking for:

· Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a 3rd line support or administration role, predominantly

working within data centre services and infrastructure.

· Minimum of 8 years’ experience with virtualization technologies i.e. VMware or Hyper-V

· Minimum of 7 years’ experience with Server operating systems; Windows Server, Linux or Unix.

· Detailed technical understanding of other datacenter technologies including storage, backup, disaster recovery and security.

· Storage connectivity experience within vCenter for troubleshooting

· OEM knowledge-based competencies, preferred.

· Ability to understand and navigate technical situations with strong problem-solving and remedy skills.

· Experience in technical project management.

· Experience in producing low-level technical designs and supporting implementation documentation.

· Experience in performing technical presentations and customer workshops.

· Fluent in English


Bonus Points:

· Vendor certifications a plus (current VCP, MCS Server Virtualization with Windows Server Hyper-V and System Center) – may be required for specific platform support needs.

· Project Management Certification (Prince2 or equivalent)


Education:

· Bachelor’s degree required.


Travel:

· 5-10%


If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to access job openings or apply for a job on this site as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by

calling .


Park Place Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer M/F/D/V.


Park Place Technologies has an in-house recruiting team that focuses exclusively on the hiring needs of our company. We are not currently accepting additional third-party agreements or unsolicited resumes. If you would like to be considered as a preferred partner with Park Place

Technologies, please submit your detailed information to . Any CVs submitted directly to hiring managers will be considered unsolicited and become the property of Park Place Technologies
