The Managed Services department is primarily focused on delivering the whole solutions lifecycle, including; Presales, design, implementing, supporting, maintaining and decommissioning data centre solutions to ensure the continuity of business operations for all customers. This role is expected to work with other members of the managed services and technical teams in implementing and supporting solutions for new and existing customers.


What you’ll be doing:

· Deliver support solutions for Managed Services customers in line with industry best practice to deliver continual service improvement over the whole service lifecycle.

· Work closely with WINTEL Team Lead to ensure new customers are migrated with seamless handover / transition from onboarding into the steady state managed service environment.

· Implementing new and refreshed managed service solutions for hosted customer environments.

· Dynamically monitor, manage and improve managed service environments. Identifying and resolving root cause of issues and ensuring continual service availability.

· Strive for continual service improvement based on a desire to become a world class managed service provider.

· Contribute proactively to new service development.

· Deliver a high-performance culture in the team with a focus on teamwork, service excellence and ownership for resolving customer issues.

· Guarantee operational procedures and practices are well defined, documented and consistently applied.

· Ensure quality, up-to-date documentation exists for all service arrangements.

· Other duties assigned


What we’re looking for:

· Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a 3rd line support or administration role, predominantly

working within data centre services and infrastructure.

· Minimum of 8 years’ experience with virtualization technologies i.e. VMware or Hyper-V

· Minimum of 7 years’ experience with Server operating systems; Windows Server, Linux or Unix.

· Detailed technical understanding of other datacenter technologies including storage, backup, disaster recovery and security.

· Storage connectivity experience within vCenter for troubleshooting

· OEM knowledge-based competencies, preferred.

· Ability to understand and navigate technical situations with strong problem-solving and remedy skills.

· Experience in technical project management.

· Experience in producing low-level technical designs and supporting implementation documentation.

· Experience in performing technical presentations and customer workshops.

· Fluent in English


Bonus Points:

· Vendor certifications a plus (current VCP, MCS Server Virtualization with Windows Server Hyper-V and System Center) – may be required for specific platform support needs.

· Project Management Certification (Prince2 or equivalent)


Education:

· Bachelor’s degree required.


Travel:

· 5-10%

calling .

title: Sr DevOps Engineer Azure (Remoto | PJ)
description:
100% Remote

USA Timezone

Contractor / PJ position



Role Overview

The goal is to shape the reliability and scalability of mission-critical platforms on Azure, Kubernetes , and modern DevOps toolchains. You will solve complex infrastructure challenges, automate end-to-end operations, and ensure systems operate with high availability, performance, and security.


What You Will Do

  • Design, build, and improve CI/CD pipelines for applications and infrastructure
  • Develop automation frameworks that reduce manual effort and increase consistency.
  • Configure and optimize cloud infrastructure to align with security, scalability, and performance best practices.
  • Collaborate with development teams to remove deployment blockers and improve delivery workflows.
  • Monitor reliability and performance, identify issues early, and implement data-driven improvements to increase uptime and efficiency.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and drive incident resolution with clear postmortems and preventive actions.
  • Maintain technical documentation for pipelines, configurations, and runbooks.
  • Perform readiness assessments and validation tests before production rollouts.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and ARM templates with version control and reproducibility.
  • Troubleshoot complex deployment, provisioning, and performance issues across multi-cloud and containerized environments.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven track record in SRE or DevOps roles operating production systems
  • Hands-on experience running production workloads on Kubernetes in a cloud environment, including cluster design, autoscaling, upgrades, and network policies.
  • Proven CI/CD delivery using GitHub Actions or Jenkins , including promotion across environments, approvals, and rollback strategies.
  • Infrastructure as Code expertise with Terraform and ARM templates, including modules, remote state, workspaces, and policy enforcement.
  • Strong scripting in PowerShell, Bash, or Python for automation and diagnostics.
  • GitOps experience with Argo CD or Flux , managing multi-environment application delivery and drift remediation.
  • Containerization with Docker and Kubernetes , including health probes, PodDisruptionBudgets, resource quotas, HorizontalPodAutoscaler, and operators.
  • Networking fundamentals with cloud network security practices such as VNet design, NSGs, Private Link, and ingress controllers.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security and compliance, including least privilege, secrets management, audit trails, and control evidence.
  • Excellent written and spoken English .
  • Ability to collaborate across US time zone .


Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Azure certification , such as Developer Associate, Administrator, or DevOps Engineer Expert

title: Senior Software Developer (.NET)
description:
Se você gosta de construir aplicações robustas, manja de boas práticas, curte trabalhar com arquitetura limpa e quer evoluir em um time que valoriza engenharia, colaboração e aprendizado contínuo, essa oportunidade é pra você!


Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?


Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Habilidades Técnicas:

- .NET Core Apis;

- Micro-serviços;

- SQL Server;

- xUnit (Testes unitários);

- Git;

- RabbitMQ;

- Metodologia ágil (Scrum).


Diferenciais:

- Kafka;

- Docker;

- CI/CD.


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Gympass - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: Tech Lead | Analytics & AI
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa Tech Lead de Analytics & AI para liderar tecnicamente um time multidisciplinar, atuando na construção de soluções baseadas em dados, machine learning e IA aplicada a problemas reais de negócio.

Essa posição é para quem combina excelência técnica, visão arquitetural e liderança, atuando próximo ao time, produto e negócio para tomar decisões técnicas, orientar o time e garantir entregas escaláveis e de qualidade.

  • Apoiar o time na resolução de desafios técnicos, removendo impedimentos e orientando decisões
  • Atuar hands-on em demandas estratégicas ou de maior complexidade
  • Traduzir necessidades de produto e negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis, sustentáveis e alinhadas ao roadmap
  • Planejar e acompanhar entregas técnicas, participando de estimativas, prazos e priorização
  • Monitorar indicadores de engenharia e qualidade, mitigando riscos técnicos
  • Garantir práticas de qualidade, como code reviews, testes automatizados e documentação
  • Mentorar e desenvolver o time, com 1:1s, feedbacks e apoio à evolução profissional
  • Atuar como ponte entre tecnologia, produto e negócio, apoiando alinhamentos e decisões técnicas
  • Trabalhar em parceria com a área de arquitetura na construção de provas de conceito (PoCs) e na análise de viabilidade técnica de soluções.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Experiência sólida em Ciência de Dados, Machine Learning e ML em produção (pipelines batch/streaming, deploy e monitoramento)
  • Capacidade de desenhar arquiteturas de dados e ML, avaliando trade-offs
  • Conhecimento em engenharia de dados (modelagem OLTP/OLAP, Data Lakes, integrações e SQL)
  • Atuação fullstack, com backend em Python e integração com frontend em React e/ou Angular
  • Domínio de boas práticas de arquitetura de software e atuação como referência técnica do time
  • Experiência com arquiteturas de IA agêntica, agentes, MCPs e integração com plataformas de IA (ex.: AWS Bedrock).
  • Experiência com IA Generativa (RAG, embeddings, chains/agents)
  • Vivência com frameworks de agentes (ex.: LangChain, LangGraph ou similares)
  • Conhecimento em Data Mesh, governança de dados e sistemas de alta escala

description:

Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. title: Product Designer (UX/UI, Consumer Web Focus)
description:
For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Product Designer to own the end-to-end user experience for our Carnegie Audiences suite of products (careerexplorer.com and supplemental products), including the integration and design of new Agentic AI interactions. You will be responsible for translating complex user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant, and effective design solutions. This role requires a strong focus on core user experience, user flows, and wireframing, in addition to high-quality visual user interface (UI) execution.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • User Experience (UX) Strategy and Design
  • Lead the design process from initial concept and user research through to final implementation and iteration, focusing on complex user flows, information architecture, and system design.
  • Develop and refine wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to communicate design intent and test hypotheses with users and stakeholders.
  • Conduct usability testing, analyze user data, and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement of the product experience.
  • Design and integrate Agentic AI experiences into product flows, ensuring a seamless, trustworthy, and effective interaction between the user and the AI system.
  • User Interface (UI) Design and Visual Execution
  • Create polished, high-fidelity visual designs and detailed design specifications that adhere to brand guidelines and accessibility standards.
  • Maintain and contribute to our existing Design System, ensuring consistency, scalability, and efficiency across all product touchpoints.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all product outputs, focusing on design principles that enhance clarity and drive user adoption.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
  • Collaboration and Implementation
  • Partner closely with Product Managers to define product strategy and requirements, ensuring design solutions align with business objectives and technical constraints.
  • Collaborate with front-end engineers to ensure accurate design implementation and a seamless, high-quality user experience post-launch.
  • Participate in agile development processes, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and design critiques.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • UX/UI Acumen: Exceptional ability to translate strategic product goals into logical user flows and visually compelling, intuitive user interfaces, evidenced by a strong public portfolio of work on consumer-facing web products.
  • Technical Design Proficiency: Expertise in current design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) for creating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and specifications.
  • Design Ownership and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a design portfolio autonomously, proactively identify design opportunities, and take ownership of the product’s end-to-end user experience.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively navigate complex design challenges and continuously seek elegant solutions that balance user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively present design rationale to non-technical stakeholders and facilitate productive design critiques.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced spoken English level (B2–C1 or higher).


Requirements:

  • Advanced Proficiency in UX Design: Deep expertise in the full lifecycle of UX design, including user research, wireframing, journey mapping, and developing interactive prototypes that demonstrate complex user flows.
  • Expert UI/Visual Design Experience: Strong, hands-on experience in high-fidelity visual design, typography, color theory, and creating/maintaining design systems for web products.
  • Consumer Web Focus: Demonstrated ability to design and launch successful consumer-facing products on the web.
  • Portfolio: Mandatory submission of a portfolio (e.g., personal website, Dribbble, GitHub) that clearly demonstrates a focus on design thinking, user flows, and high-end aesthetic execution for consumer web applications.


Nice-to-haves:

  • AI/ML Design: Experience designing user experiences for AI/ML-powered features or familiarity with the principles of Agentic AI.
  • Familiarity with motion design and animation principles to enhance user interactions.
  • Proficiency with front-end code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript frameworks) to facilitate better collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in Design, HCI, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on Product Design (UX/UI) for consumer-facing web applications, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Product Designer to own the end-to-end user experience for our Carnegie Audiences suite of products (careerexplorer.com and supplemental products), including the integration and design of new Agentic AI interactions. You will be responsible for translating complex user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant, and effective design solutions.   • Lead the design process from initial concept and user research through to final implementation and iteration, focusing on complex user flows, information architecture, and system design.

  • Conduct usability testing, analyze user data, and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement of the product experience.
  • Design and integrate Agentic AI experiences into product flows, ensuring a seamless, trustworthy, and effective interaction between the user and the AI system.
  • User Interface (UI) Design and Visual Execution
  • Create polished, high-fidelity visual designs and detailed design specifications that adhere to brand guidelines and accessibility standards.
  • Maintain and contribute to our existing Design System, ensuring consistency, scalability, and efficiency across all product touchpoints.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all product outputs, focusing on design principles that enhance clarity and drive user adoption.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
  • Collaboration and Implementation
  • Partner closely with Product Managers to define product strategy and requirements, ensuring design solutions align with business objectives and technical constraints.
  • Collaborate with front-end engineers to ensure accurate design implementation and a seamless, high-quality user experience post-launch.
  • Participate in agile development processes, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and design critiques.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • UX/UI Acumen: Exceptional ability to translate strategic product goals into logical user flows and visually compelling, intuitive user interfaces, evidenced by a strong public portfolio of work on consumer-facing web products.
  • Technical Design Proficiency: Expertise in current design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) for creating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and specifications.

  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively navigate complex design challenges and continuously seek elegant solutions that balance user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively present design rationale to non-technical stakeholders and facilitate productive design critiques.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced spoken English level (B2–C1 or higher).

title: Consultor(a) SAP SR
description:
Somos a SEIDOR, multinacional de tecnologia e inovação, que oferece um portfólio completo de soluções e serviços para promover a competitividade e a transformação das organizações. São mais de 40 anos acreditando na tecnologia , com 85 escritórios e uma equipe de mais de 7.500 profissionais na Europa, América Latina, Estados Unidos, África, Oriente Médio e Ásia.


Somos parceiros platinum da SAP e temos mais de 8.500 clientes . Nosso portfólio completo é voltado para empresas grandes, médias e em crescimento. Na SEIDOR acreditamos que, para enfrentar os novos desafios do mundo digital, devemos ter os melhores aliados, as tecnologias líderes de mercado e, acima de tudo, as melhores pessoas.


Nós acreditamos no valor das pessoas . Buscamos constantemente atrair e reter talentos, investindo no desenvolvimento de nossos colaboradores e oferecendo oportunidades de crescimento profissional. Nosso time é composto por profissionais colaborativos, autônomos e ágeis que juntos formam um ambiente de trabalho desafiador, dinâmico e sem discriminação, respeitando as diferenças que nos tornam mais humanos.


✨ Venha fazer parte desse novo projeto! ✨

Tem os requisitos abaixo? Então essas vagas são para você ! ✨

  • Consultor(a) SAP S/4HANA PS SR
  • Consultor(a) SAP S/4HANA FI SR
  • Consultor(a) SAP S/4HANA MM SR
  • Consultor(a) SAP S/4HANA PM-PP SR
  • Consultor(a) SAP S/4HANA SD-CS SR
  • Consultor(a) SAP S/4HANA CO SR


Sobre as oportunidades:

  • Início: Assim que aprovado.
  • Prazo: 12 meses renováveis.
  • Atividades: Atuação em projeto de conversão para SAP S/4HANA , conduzindo análise de impacto, adequação e estabilização de processos nos módulos FI, CO, MM, SD-CS, PS, PP e PM . Responsável por: Liderar diagnóstico de impactos da conversão (processos, dados e integrações); Garantir integração end-to-end entre áreas financeira, controladoria, suprimentos, vendas, projetos, manutenção e produção; Revisar e estabilizar processos ponta a ponta; Planejar e executar testes (unitários, integrados, UAT e regressão); Atuar em cutover e hypercare, assegurando consistência de saldos, estoques, custos e faturamento; Garantir compliance contábil/fiscal e integridade de dados mestres; Suportar estabilização pós-go-live, atuando na resolução de incidentes críticos e governança de correções.
  • Local: Atuação remota com solicitações de idas esporádicas sob demanda.
  • Despesas: Reembolsáveis.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida em SAP ECC e/ou S/4HANA no módulo de atuação (FI, CO, MM, SD, PS, PM ou PP).
  • Participação em ao menos um projeto de conversão ECC → S/4HANA ou rollout.
  • Conhecimento dos impactos de S/4HANA no respectivo módulo (simplificações, mudanças de processos e dados).
  • Experiência com testes (unitário, integrado, UAT) e validação de consistência (saldos, estoques, custos ou documentos, conforme módulo).
  • Vivência em cutover e suporte pós-go-live (hypercare).
  • Familiaridade com Fiori e integrações com módulos correlatos.

Desejável:

  • Residir no Rio de Janeiro - RJ

title: Desenvolvedor de Mobile
description:
VAGA — DESENVOLVEDOR MOBILE (PLENO / SÊNIOR)

Empresa: Atman


FAIXA SALARIAL

R$ 4.500 a R$ 9.000 (CLT)

Enquadramento conforme avaliação técnica.


SOBRE A VAGA

Vaga para desenvolvimento de aplicativos mobile voltados a produtos digitais, com consumo de APIs complexas, dados em tempo real, integração com hardware e dispositivos, uso de mapas e geolocalização e atuação em aplicações operacionais e críticas.


Os aplicativos suportam configuração de dispositivos, comunicação contínua com backend e operação em ambientes que exigem estabilidade, desempenho e confiabilidade em produção.


RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicativos mobile Android e iOS
  • Implementação de aplicações em React Native
  • Integração com APIs REST e comunicação em tempo real (WebSockets)
  • Integração com hardware e dispositivos
  • Implementação de funcionalidades com mapas e geolocalização
  • Atuação em apps operacionais e críticos
  • Garantia de estabilidade, performance e confiabilidade
  • Gerenciamento de estado, ciclo de vida e comunicação assíncrona
  • Integração com times de backend, frontend web, hardware e produto


STACK E CONHECIMENTOS TÉCNICOS (OBRIGATÓRIOS)

  • React Native
  • TypeScript e JavaScript
  • Consumo de APIs REST
  • Comunicação em tempo real (WebSockets)
  • Integração com hardware / dispositivos
  • Uso de mapas e geolocalização
  • Conceitos de performance mobile
  • Versionamento com Git


DIFERENCIAIS

  • Espanhol ou Italiano a nível de conversação serão considerados um grande diferencial.
  • Experiência com Android nativo (Kotlin)
  • Experiência com apps publicados em loja
  • Vivência com aplicações operacionais ou críticas
  • Integração com dispositivos físicos


REQUISITOS

  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos com desenvolvimento mobile
  • Inglês intermediário a avançado
  • Graduação em Engenharias, Ciência da Computação, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas


PERFIL TÉCNICO ESPERADO

  • Perfil analítico
  • Capacidade técnica elevada
  • Facilidade para resolver problemas complexos
  • Atenção a impacto em produção, estabilidade e desempenho


REGIME DE CONTRATAÇÃO E BENEFÍCIOS

Regime de contratação: CLT Presencial

Jornada de trabalho: Segunda a sexta-feira, das 08h às 17h

Benefícios:

  • Vale alimentação
  • Vale refeição
  • Plano de saúde Unimed
  • Plano odontológico
  • Seguro de vida
  • Plano de carreira estruturado


CANDIDATURA

Os interessados devem enviar currículo para o e-mail , informando no assunto a área de interesse.

title: Gerente de Investigação Forense
description:
Este grupo multinacional líder, com operações significativas nas Américas e em todo o mundo, busca um Gerente de Investigação Forense experiente para liderar uma equipe de investigadores corporativos em suas operações regionais.


Sediado em Belo Horizonte, você será responsável por gerir uma equipe de especialistas forenses e supervisionar investigações de crimes financeiros complexos, incluindo conflitos de interesse, fraudes em compras e suprimentos, apropriação indébita de ativos, má gestão financeira, corrupção e suborno.


Sua função será focada primordialmente na liderança da equipe, definindo objetivos estratégicos de desempenho e construindo relacionamentos para garantir a fluidez das operações regionais. Você terá a responsabilidade diária pela gestão dos especialistas forenses, fornecendo orientação para o desenvolvimento de carreira e supervisionando a alocação de recursos. Além disso, você será o principal ponto de contato para a gestão operacional, desempenhando um papel fundamental na estratégia geral dos objetivos de investigação do grupo.


Somado às funções de liderança, você conduzirá projetos de investigação corporativa de alto nível, ministrará treinamentos de conscientização sobre fraudes e supervisionará a integração de ferramentas de análise de dados (data analytics) nos fluxos de trabalho investigativos.


Para ter sucesso nesta função, é fundamental possuir sólida experiência na condução de investigações corporativas complexas e na gestão de equipes forenses especializadas. Provavelmente, você já atua em um cargo de gerência em uma consultoria forense ou em uma função similar no setor corporativo.

Embora a certificação CFE seja muito bem-vinda, valorizamos sua capacidade comprovada de liderar equipes de alto desempenho e gerenciar o relacionamento com stakeholders seniores.


Excelentes habilidades de comunicação são essenciais, sendo obrigatória a fluência em português e inglês. Conhecimento em espanhol e experiência com ferramentas avançadas de análise de dados serão considerados diferenciais significativos

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. title: Business Development Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Development Managerto join our team. As a rapidly growing company, we are looking for talented individuals committed to helping us achieve our goals. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of driven individuals dedicated to making a difference in the industry.



Responsibilities

  • Proactively recruit and develop effective local partnerships with merchandise partners, manufacturers, and brands. Focus on categories selections to increase overall value, in alignment with business and customer needs.
  • Assist merchandise partners in establishing themselves on the platform and their growth.Guide merchandise partners in developing comprehensive plans including market positioning, product planning, brand marketing, and operational strategies.
  • Propose innovative ideas based on the current status of the categories, as well as create and implement projects through resource integration and merchant guidance.
  • Conduct industry analysis reports, explore potential customer needs through data analysis, and adjust strategies accordingly based on market trends.


Required skills / Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of operational experience, including but not limited to experience in brand management or platform operations.
  • Extensive connections and relationships with local seller and vendor networks is a plus.
  • Strong data analysis skills, able to analyze industry trends and project management through data, and summarize conclusions.
  • Possesses market exploration and marketing innovation capabilities, capable of guiding overall merchant marketing plans.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, self-motivation, ability to think strategically and adapt quickly to changes.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage logistics during high-demand periods.


Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.


Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer – Distributed Systems

Duration: 3 months initially (strong extension potential)

Day Rate: £250 (B2B Contractor - Approx. $340)

Location: Remote (UK / EU Time Zones Preferred)


We’re seeking an experienced Data Engineer to help build and scale a distributed event processing system handling - 1 billion events per day within a fast-growing advertising analytics company.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and optimise distributed data processing systems
  • Build high-throughput event pipelines in Go and/or Python
  • Work within a large Data Build Tools instance transforming data in a warehouse
  • Improve system performance and scalability
  • Collaborate closely with the Technical Lead and small engineering team
  • Contribute to architectural decisions for a new distributed system


Required Experience:

  • Strong experience building distributed systems
  • Proven experience processing high-volume event data
  • Production-level Go and/or Python experience
  • Strong SQL skills (data warehousing context)
  • Experience working with Data Build Tools
  • Ability to work independently and deliver value quickly
  • Experience in advertising, analytics, or large-scale data platforms is advantageous

title: Lead Engineer (JAVA)
description:
We Are Sportingtech :


Sportingtech is a multi-award-winning provider of turnkey betting and gaming solutions designed for regulated and emerging markets around the world. With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.



Where you Fit In:


As a JAVA Lead Engineer , you are a senior, hands-on engineer responsible for designing and delivering high-quality Java-based solutions in a transactional, distributed environment. You shape and execute technical direction in close collaboration with Architecture and Principal Engineers, ensuring the team’s implementation aligns with agreed standards, target architecture, and operational constraints.


The impact you will have:


Hands-on engineering & delivery (primary)

  • Design, implement, and maintain backend services and APIs primarily in Java (and relevant frameworks) with strong engineering discipline.
  • Own complex technical work end-to-end: implementation, testing, deployment readiness, and production validation.
  • Drive high-quality code practices: reviews, refactoring, performance tuning, and technical debt management.


Technical leadership in partnership

  • Collaborate with Architects and Principal Engineers to align on technical direction, reference architectures, and platform standards.
  • Translate architectural direction into executable team-level designs: service boundaries, integration patterns, transactional consistency, and data-access strategy.
  • Lead technical discovery/spikes and propose pragmatic options with trade-offs.


Transactional systems & data engineering

  • Design for correctness and integrity using transactional databases (SQL, schema evolution, indexing, query performance).
  • Handle concurrency, consistency models, idempotency, and failure modes (retries, sagas/outbox patterns where applicable).
  • Ensure safe migrations and backward-compatible changes to data structures and service contracts.

With offices in Malta, Bulgaria, London, Brazil and Portugal, our iGaming platform offers everything covering sportsbook and casino via a modular system and intuitive back office for a fully omni-channel solution. Our unparalleled ability to cater for local-market customisation and operator preferences provides players with an optimal betting experience, resulting in proven growth for our rapidly expanding customer base.



Where you Fit In:


As a JAVA Lead Engineer , you are a senior, hands-on engineer responsible for designing and delivering high-quality Java-based solutions in a transactional, distributed environment. You shape and execute technical direction in close collaboration with Architecture and Principal Engineers, ensuring the team’s implementation aligns with agreed standards, target architecture, and operational constraints.


The impact you will have:


Hands-on engineering & delivery (primary)

  • Design, implement, and maintain backend services and APIs primarily in Java (and relevant frameworks) with strong engineering discipline.
  • Own complex technical work end-to-end: implementation, testing, deployment readiness, and production validation.
  • Drive high-quality code practices: reviews, refactoring, performance tuning, and technical debt management.


Technical leadership in partnership

  • Collaborate with Architects and Principal Engineers to align on technical direction, reference architectures, and platform standards.
  • Translate architectural direction into executable team-level designs: service boundaries, integration patterns, transactional consistency, and data-access strategy.
  • Lead technical discovery/spikes and propose pragmatic options with trade-offs.


Transactional systems & data engineering

  • Design for correctness and integrity using transactional databases (SQL, schema evolution, indexing, query performance).
  • Handle concurrency, consistency models, idempotency, and failure modes (retries, sagas/outbox patterns where applicable).
  • Ensure safe migrations and backward-compatible changes to data structures and service contracts.


Mentorship & team enablement

  • Mentor engineers through pairing, code reviews, design sessions, and technical coaching.
  • Raise team capability in Java engineering practices, distributed systems thinking, and operational hygiene.


Quality, reliability, and operability (“build it, run it”)

  • Embed robust testing aligned to service criticality working closely with Quality Assurance Engineers.
  • Partner with Performance Engineers and IT Operations to ensure operational readiness: monitoring, alerting, dashboards, runbooks, and production access patterns.
  • Participate in incident response as needed; work with the incident team on follow-ups (RCA actions, preventative fixes, resilience improvements).



What we’re looking for:


We are looking for a Technical Leader with solid experience in Java and related technologies.


  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent field.
  • Professional software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on backend/service work.
  • Strong Java expertise and common ecosystem frameworks (e.g., Spring / similar) and build/test tooling.
  • Strong SQL and transactional DB fundamentals (modeling, migrations, performance, locking/concurrency implications).
  • Distributed systems fundamentals: latency, resiliency patterns, observability, and debugging in production.
  • Strong testing discipline; familiarity with CI/CD best practices.
  • Demonstrable ownership of production systems in a transactional domain.
  • Advanced English.
  • Clear communication and alignment skills across Architecture, Principal Engineers, Product, QA, NOC, and IT Ops.


This role is Remote based in Brazil.



Sportingtech is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. By applying for a role at Sportingtech, you acknowledge and agree to the terms of our Candidates and Employees Privacy Policy. Please read this policy carefully to understand how we handle your personal data.

description:
Somos fanáticos por pessoas!


Demonstramos isso oferecendo uma cultura de pertencimento, caminhos claros para desenvolvimento de carreira, programas de apoio profissional, coaching e mentoria, além de uma rede global de amigos e colegas que estarão ao seu lado. (E tem muito mais!).

Quer trabalhar em uma multinacional certificada como Great Place to Work, apoiar as melhores marcas do mercado, inovar e mudar o mundo – tudo isso enquanto constrói conexões reais e desenvolve sua carreira?


Então venha ser um #gamechanger !


Descrição da Vaga


Funções Essenciais / Responsabilidades Principais

  • Mapear, desenhar soluções, materiais, validar e apresentar conteúdos na lingua Inglesa/Portuguesa;
  • Conduzir pesquisas e análises da marcas de nossos clientes, melhores praticas, ecossistema, indústria, concorrentes e identificar tendências;
  • Realizar análise matemática de indicadores operacionais e de negócio;

Desejável:

  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de processos como Visio, Bizagi, MSOffice, etc;
  • Conhecimento básico em estatística;
  • Certificações como Agile, Lean 6Sigma,BPM e correlatas.


Todas as nossas vagas são elegíveis para Pessoas com Deficiência.

title: Purchasing Agent - Buyer
description:
Please note that the role requires Excellent communication skills in English (both written & oral).


Please share the resumes in English only.


BASIC PURPOSE: Support and expedite supply chain operations, process orders, and execute sourcing activities for orders. Manage all purchases for assigned vessels and processing on POs accordingly.


POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Support operations for the purchasing process, primarily requisitioning and ordering.
  • Ensure all requisitions are compliant with the company’s policies.
  • Expedite inventory and direct charge purchase orders for multiple ships as required and in accordance with purchasing procedures.
  • Complete the processing of manual purchase orders.
  • Ensure all necessary approvals are documented, the orders are placed, and shipments are delivered on time.
  • Perform sourcing activities and get quotes on all items for POs for assigned vessels.
  • Ensure the items and prices are accurately listed in the PO.
  • Work with the sourcing team(s) and suppliers to get quotes on new items.
  • Ensure that all users, approvals, and filters are set up in accordance with the company’s procurement policies.
  • Serve as the help desk for users relating to the purchasing tools employed.
  • Coordinate processes with the accounts payable function to facilitate the enforcement of established policies.
  • Support implementation and management of ongoing operations for eProcurement solutions.
  • Regularly meet with the management to seek ongoing direction, coaching,and support as required.
  • Perform other job-related functions as assigned.


KNOWLEDGE AND EXPERIENCE:

EDUCATION: Bachelor’s degree in Business or other related field of study; or any equivalent combination of experience and skills.


EXPERIENCE: Minimum 1 year of experience with procurement operations, ERP (e.g. PeopleSoft), eProcurement, eCatalog, contract management, eRFX, and eAuction strategies and technologies.


KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS:

  • Good teamwork skills to work with other company departments to plan and execute enhancement, upgrade, and ongoing deployment of the above technologies.
  • Strong facilitation skills to communicate and collaborate with stakeholders across the company to implement Procure-to-Pay (P2P) technologies.
  • Demonstrated success in gathering data, conducting analyses, and generating high-quality outputs.
  • Experience with process, quality control, and workflow management and design preferred. Numerical accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills. Ability to multi-task and problem solve.
  • An understanding of leading P2P technology practices and trends (e.g. MXP, Amos, Ariba), general experience of network administration preferred.
  • Experience with ERP and P2P systems (e.g. MXP, Amos, Ariba, PeopleSoft), proficiency in Microsoft suite (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint).


To Executive Search Firms & Staffing Agencies: NCLH does not accept unsolicited resumes from any agencies. All unsolicited resumes will be considered NCLH property, and NCLH will not be obligated to pay a referral fee. This includes resumes submitted directly to Hiring Managers without contacting the NCLH Human Resources Talent Acquisition Department.

title: Technical Support Engineer - Level 3 (VMWare)
description:
About the Company

Park Place Technologies is a global data center and networking optimization firm. Powered by the world’s largest on-the-ground engineering team, a robust group of advanced engineers and our fully staffed, 24x7x365 Enterprise Operations Center, we offer a robust portfolio of IT solutions to optimize networking and data center Uptime and performance. As the industry leader, our 2500 Park Place Associates provide support to 21,000+ customers in more than 180+ countries. We are proud to service 90% of Fortune 500 companies and 40% of Forbes 100 clients. Our company’s strength and success are a credit to our Associates, and Park Place Life is how we communicate and deliver our culture internally. We have been awarded as a NorthCoast 99 “Best Workplace” winner for 14 consecutive years in recognition of our employee commitment. Park Place Life is about collaboration, responsiveness, diversity, and integrity, and represents everything that makes our company great and our culture unique.


Technical Support Engineer Level 3 – Wintel/VMWare


The Technical Support Engineer L3 is responsible for proactively responding to the technical challenges and requirements for customers within the Managed Services environments. The Managed Services department is primarily focused on delivering the whole solutions lifecycle, including; Presales, design, implementing, supporting, maintaining and decommissioning data centre solutions to ensure the continuity of business operations for all customers. This role is expected to work with other members of the managed services and technical teams in implementing and supporting solutions for new and existing customers.


What you’ll be doing:

· Deliver support solutions for Managed Services customers in line with industry best practice to deliver continual service improvement over the whole service lifecycle.

· Work closely with WINTEL Team Lead to ensure new customers are migrated with seamless handover / transition from onboarding into the steady state managed service environment.

· Implementing new and refreshed managed service solutions for hosted customer environments.

· Dynamically monitor, manage and improve managed service environments. Identifying and resolving root cause of issues and ensuring continual service availability.

· Strive for continual service improvement based on a desire to become a world class managed service provider.

· Contribute proactively to new service development.

· Deliver a high-performance culture in the team with a focus on teamwork, service excellence and ownership for resolving customer issues.

· Guarantee operational procedures and practices are well defined, documented and consistently applied.

· Ensure quality, up-to-date documentation exists for all service arrangements.

· Other duties assigned


What we’re looking for:

· Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a 3rd line support or administration role, predominantly

working within data centre services and infrastructure.

· Minimum of 8 years’ experience with virtualization technologies i.e. VMware or Hyper-V

· Minimum of 7 years’ experience with Server operating systems; Windows Server, Linux or Unix.

· Detailed technical understanding of other datacenter technologies including storage, backup, disaster recovery and security.

· Storage connectivity experience within vCenter for troubleshooting

· OEM knowledge-based competencies, preferred.

· Ability to understand and navigate technical situations with strong problem-solving and remedy skills.

· Experience in technical project management.

· Experience in producing low-level technical designs and supporting implementation documentation.

· Experience in performing technical presentations and customer workshops.

· Fluent in English


Bonus Points:

· Vendor certifications a plus (current VCP, MCS Server Virtualization with Windows Server Hyper-V and System Center) – may be required for specific platform support needs.

· Project Management Certification (Prince2 or equivalent)


Education:

· Bachelor’s degree required.


Travel:

· 5-10%


If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to access job openings or apply for a job on this site as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by

calling .


Park Place Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer M/F/D/V.


Park Place Technologies has an in-house recruiting team that focuses exclusively on the hiring needs of our company. We are not currently accepting additional third-party agreements or unsolicited resumes. If you would like to be considered as a preferred partner with Park Place

Technologies, please submit your detailed information to . Any CVs submitted directly to hiring managers will be considered unsolicited and become the property of Park Place Technologies

description:

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo 7º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília


Sobre a vaga:

Buscamos profissional de nível sênior especializado no desenvolvimento .NET e experiência na execução de testes que tenha disponibilidade para atuar em um projeto pontual (temporário).


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolvimento e migração de aplicações back-end e integrações de sistemas
  • Participar da análise técnica de soluções e estimativas
  • Garantir qualidade e boas práticas de codificação
  • Apoiar na construção de testes e integração contínua

  • Experiência com ferramentas de integração contínua como Jenkins
  • Controle de versionamento com GitLab
  • Integrações e consumo de APIs REST e SOAP
  • Experiência com IA será um diferencial
  • Experiência em arquitetura e migração de soluções para cloud, com foco em Azure, incluindo Azure Functions, AKS e Logic Apps

title: Sr DevOps Engineer Azure (Remoto | PJ)
description:
100% Remote

USA Timezone

Contractor / PJ position



Role Overview

The goal is to shape the reliability and scalability of mission-critical platforms on Azure, Kubernetes , and modern DevOps toolchains. You will solve complex infrastructure challenges, automate end-to-end operations, and ensure systems operate with high availability, performance, and security.


What You Will Do

  • Design, build, and improve CI/CD pipelines for applications and infrastructure
  • Develop automation frameworks that reduce manual effort and increase consistency.
  • Configure and optimize cloud infrastructure to align with security, scalability, and performance best practices.
  • Collaborate with development teams to remove deployment blockers and improve delivery workflows.
  • Monitor reliability and performance, identify issues early, and implement data-driven improvements to increase uptime and efficiency.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and drive incident resolution with clear postmortems and preventive actions.
  • Maintain technical documentation for pipelines, configurations, and runbooks.
  • Perform readiness assessments and validation tests before production rollouts.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and ARM templates with version control and reproducibility.
  • Troubleshoot complex deployment, provisioning, and performance issues across multi-cloud and containerized environments.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven track record in SRE or DevOps roles operating production systems
  • Hands-on experience running production workloads on Kubernetes in a cloud environment, including cluster design, autoscaling, upgrades, and network policies.
  • Proven CI/CD delivery using GitHub Actions or Jenkins , including promotion across environments, approvals, and rollback strategies.
  • Infrastructure as Code expertise with Terraform and ARM templates, including modules, remote state, workspaces, and policy enforcement.
  • Strong scripting in PowerShell, Bash, or Python for automation and diagnostics.
  • GitOps experience with Argo CD or Flux , managing multi-environment application delivery and drift remediation.
  • Containerization with Docker and Kubernetes , including health probes, PodDisruptionBudgets, resource quotas, HorizontalPodAutoscaler, and operators.
  • Networking fundamentals with cloud network security practices such as VNet design, NSGs, Private Link, and ingress controllers.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security and compliance, including least privilege, secrets management, audit trails, and control evidence.
  • Excellent written and spoken English .
  • Ability to collaborate across US time zone .


Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Azure certification , such as Developer Associate, Administrator, or DevOps Engineer Expert
  • Observability using Application Insights, Elastic Stack (ELK), Grafana, and Prometheus for metrics, logs, and traces.
  • Experience with log aggregation and alerting at scale using Elastic and Prometheus.
  • Understanding of high availability, scalability, disaster recovery, and cost optimization strategies.
  • Experience managing Windows-based containerized applications .


Plus

  • Experience in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or AWS

title: Senior Software Developer (.NET)
description:
Se você gosta de construir aplicações robustas, manja de boas práticas, curte trabalhar com arquitetura limpa e quer evoluir em um time que valoriza engenharia, colaboração e aprendizado contínuo, essa oportunidade é pra você!


Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?

- .NET Core Apis;

- Micro-serviços;

- SQL Server;

- xUnit (Testes unitários);

- Git;

- RabbitMQ;

- Metodologia ágil (Scrum).


Diferenciais:

- Kafka;

- Docker;

- CI/CD.


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

title: Tech Lead | Analytics & AI
description:
Buscamos uma pessoa Tech Lead de Analytics & AI para liderar tecnicamente um time multidisciplinar, atuando na construção de soluções baseadas em dados, machine learning e IA aplicada a problemas reais de negócio.

Essa posição é para quem combina excelência técnica, visão arquitetural e liderança, atuando próximo ao time, produto e negócio para tomar decisões técnicas, orientar o time e garantir entregas escaláveis e de qualidade.


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Liderar tecnicamente o time, com protagonismo na definição de padrões de desenvolvimento, arquitetura e boas práticas
  • Apoiar o time na resolução de desafios técnicos, removendo impedimentos e orientando decisões
  • Atuar hands-on em demandas estratégicas ou de maior complexidade
  • Traduzir necessidades de produto e negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis, sustentáveis e alinhadas ao roadmap
  • Planejar e acompanhar entregas técnicas, participando de estimativas, prazos e priorização
  • Monitorar indicadores de engenharia e qualidade, mitigando riscos técnicos
  • Garantir práticas de qualidade, como code reviews, testes automatizados e documentação
  • Mentorar e desenvolver o time, com 1:1s, feedbacks e apoio à evolução profissional
  • Atuar como ponte entre tecnologia, produto e negócio, apoiando alinhamentos e decisões técnicas
  • Trabalhar em parceria com a área de arquitetura na construção de provas de conceito (PoCs) e na análise de viabilidade técnica de soluções.


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Experiência sólida em Ciência de Dados, Machine Learning e ML em produção (pipelines batch/streaming, deploy e monitoramento)
  • Capacidade de desenhar arquiteturas de dados e ML, avaliando trade-offs
  • Conhecimento em engenharia de dados (modelagem OLTP/OLAP, Data Lakes, integrações e SQL)
  • Atuação fullstack, com backend em Python e integração com frontend em React e/ou Angular
  • Domínio de boas práticas de arquitetura de software e atuação como referência técnica do time
  • Experiência com arquiteturas de IA agêntica, agentes, MCPs e integração com plataformas de IA (ex.: AWS Bedrock).
  • Experiência com IA Generativa (RAG, embeddings, chains/agents)
  • Vivência com frameworks de agentes (ex.: LangChain, LangGraph ou similares)
  • Conhecimento em Data Mesh, governança de dados e sistemas de alta escala


LOCALIDADE

Uberlândia/MG – Presencial

São Paulo/SP – Híbrido (2x/semana no escritório)

Outras localidades – Remoto

▪️ Regime de contratação: CLT


BENEFÍCIOS

Remuneração Variável + Participação nos Resultados (PPR)

title: Engenheiro de IA Sênior
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Sobre a posição

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior / AI CoE Lead para atuar na construção do Centro de Excelência em IA.

O profissional será responsável por estruturar a plataforma corporativa de IA, garantindo escalabilidade, governança, segurança e controle de custos, acelerando a adoção de GenAI na organização.


Responsabilidades

Desenvolver CLI corporativo para invocação de agentes.

Criar runtime de agentes e registry de skills.

Desenvolver LLM Gateway corporativo com controle de uso e rate limiting.

Garantir versionamento de agentes e skills.

Implementar logging estruturado de prompts e outputs.

Implementar mecanismos de auditoria, filtros de input/output e controle de dados sensíveis.

Apoiar a definição de tiers de uso (n8n) e stack oficial de modelos.

Criar métricas executivas de uso de IA, telemetria e observabilidade.

Integrar soluções com Kubernetes e CI/CD a nível arquitetural.


Requisitos

Inglês avançado para comunicação global.

Forte experiência em Back-end com Node.js ou Python.

Sólidos conhecimentos em arquitetura de APIs, sistemas distribuídos e arquitetura multi-tenant.

Experiência prática com autenticação (OAuth, JWT, RBAC).

Experiência com observabilidade (logs e métricas).

Domínio de versionamento semântico e testes automatizados.

Perfil AI-Native mandatório (uso diário de Copilot, Cursor, Codeium ou similares).


Diferenciais

Experiência com LLM APIs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI).

Experiência com RAG.

Conhecimento sobre prompt injection.

Experiência em colocar GenAI em produção.

Implementação de controle de custos e criação de abstrações reutilizáveis.


Formato de trabalho: Hibrido 2 a 3 dias em Alphaville.


E temos o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Location: Brazil (Remote)


**Resumes must be submitted in English to be considered**

Telesign connects, protects and proactively defends companies, customers and the digital interactions between them. With powerful AI that delivers identity with speed, accuracy and global reach, we enable Continuous Trust. Empowering companies to transact, communicate and engage with their customers free of fear, Continuous Trust makes the promise of the digital economy possible.


Sales Development Representative position is a position within Telesign’s Market Development department. SDR is a coordination point between Market Development and Sales, and responsible for opportunity generation and hand-off to Sales. SDR is the first contact between a potential customer and Telesign and is responsible for shaping Telesign’s sales development strategy in the assigned region.


Key Responsibilities


  • Work closely with Market Research team to Identify key companies within the assigned region and key people within target accounts
  • Generate emails for Outreach.io, make cold-calls to map and penetrate accounts on the assigned Bounty List
  • Demonstrating a clear understanding of sales processes and product and service value propositions
  • Actively seeking out new potential client accounts and making the first contact with those accounts to generate interest
  • Generate sales appointments and directly influence sales pipeline
  • Lead management and CRM activities using Salesforce.com
  • Develop and maintain territory plan from your assigned geography
  • Weekly reporting on territory updates, industry trends, regional insights, competition news, etc
  • Participation in Sales Development projects that have wider impact on Market Development, Sales and other teams in the company
  • Actively contribute, build and innovate TeleSign’s sales development program and processes


Essential Requirements


  • Fluent spoken and written Portuguese , English (C1 level) and Spanish is a Plus.
  • University degree (business, economics, political and social sciences, linguistics and similar)
  • 2 - 4 years on similar business development or sales related positions
  • Lead generation, account management, or sales experience (SaaS sales a plus, but not required)
  • Office suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) user
  • Strong time management skills – ability to multi-task and prioritize in a fast-paced environment;
  • Strong drive to achieve results with minimal supervision
  • Strong organizational skills and proactive, innovative approach;
  • Strong communication, interpersonal and negotiation skills;
  • Desire to be in technology sales and have a growth mindset for a long-term career in sales
  • The passion and drive to deliver an exceptional level of achievements;
  • Interest in learning about new communication technologies
  • Experience of CRM (especially Salesforce.com) is a plus

title: Analista I Desenvolvimento de Software | Python/IA
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


DESAFIO

Estamos em busca de um(a) desenvolvedor(a) júnior para integrar nosso time e

atuar na melhoria de sistemas de crawling de sites e na criação e manutenção de sistemas

de antifraude, utilizando Inteligência Artificial.

  • Manter e expandir sistemas de crawlers de sites utilizando tecnologias tradicionais e/ou de
  • inteligência artificial com LLMs;
  • Apoiar no desenvolvimento e manutenção de soluções de IA aplicadas a antifraude;
  • Trabalhar com LLMs para análise, classificação, extração e interpretação de informações;
  • Auxiliar na criação e melhoria de prompts e fluxos de IA generativa;
  • Atuar em projetos de OCR, visão computacional e validação de documentos;
  • Apoiar na análise de evidências e padrões relacionados a fraudes;
  • Desenvolver e consumir APIs simples para integração das soluções;
  • Executar testes, validações e análises básicas dos modelos;
  • Documentar funcionalidades e apoiar na organização das entregas técnicas.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA

  • Conhecimento em Python;
  • Noções de Inteligência Artificial e Machine Learning;
  • Interesse ou experiência inicial com LLMs e IA Generativa;
  • Conhecimento básico em containers (Ex.: Docker);
  • Familiaridade com bibliotecas como: Scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow ou similares;
  • Noções de consumo/criação de APIs;
  • Conhecimento básico em Git e controle de versão.
  • Noções de crawlers de sites e ferramentas relacionadas: Scrapy, Selenium/Playwright, BeautifulSoup, etc;


VOCÊ VAI BRILHAR AINDA MAIS SE TIVER:

  • Interesse ou experiência em sistemas de antifraude;
  • Experiência com crawlers avançados (ex: com proteções de captcha, proxies, sites dinâmicos com Javascript, etc);
  • Conhecimentos de sistemas Linux;
  • Conhecimentos de código limpo e melhores práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Conhecimentos em testes de unidade e integração;
  • Noções de prompt engineering;
  • Conhecimento básico em OCR, processamento de imagens ou documentos;
  • Experiência acadêmica ou prática com projetos de IA;
  • Curiosidade sobre análise de padrões, anomalias e validações automatizadas.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Product Designer (UX/UI, Consumer Web Focus)
description:
For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Product Designer to own the end-to-end user experience for our Carnegie Audiences suite of products (careerexplorer.com and supplemental products), including the integration and design of new Agentic AI interactions. You will be responsible for translating complex user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant, and effective design solutions. This role requires a strong focus on core user experience, user flows, and wireframing, in addition to high-quality visual user interface (UI) execution.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • User Experience (UX) Strategy and Design
  • Lead the design process from initial concept and user research through to final implementation and iteration, focusing on complex user flows, information architecture, and system design.
  • Develop and refine wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to communicate design intent and test hypotheses with users and stakeholders.
  • Conduct usability testing, analyze user data, and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement of the product experience.
  • Design and integrate Agentic AI experiences into product flows, ensuring a seamless, trustworthy, and effective interaction between the user and the AI system.
  • User Interface (UI) Design and Visual Execution
  • Create polished, high-fidelity visual designs and detailed design specifications that adhere to brand guidelines and accessibility standards.
  • Maintain and contribute to our existing Design System, ensuring consistency, scalability, and efficiency across all product touchpoints.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all product outputs, focusing on design principles that enhance clarity and drive user adoption.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
  • Collaboration and Implementation
  • Partner closely with Product Managers to define product strategy and requirements, ensuring design solutions align with business objectives and technical constraints.
  • Collaborate with front-end engineers to ensure accurate design implementation and a seamless, high-quality user experience post-launch.
  • Participate in agile development processes, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and design critiques.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • UX/UI Acumen: Exceptional ability to translate strategic product goals into logical user flows and visually compelling, intuitive user interfaces, evidenced by a strong public portfolio of work on consumer-facing web products.
  • Technical Design Proficiency: Expertise in current design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) for creating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and specifications.
  • Design Ownership and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a design portfolio autonomously, proactively identify design opportunities, and take ownership of the product’s end-to-end user experience.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively navigate complex design challenges and continuously seek elegant solutions that balance user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively present design rationale to non-technical stakeholders and facilitate productive design critiques.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced spoken English level (B2–C1 or higher).


Requirements:

  • Advanced Proficiency in UX Design: Deep expertise in the full lifecycle of UX design, including user research, wireframing, journey mapping, and developing interactive prototypes that demonstrate complex user flows.
  • Expert UI/Visual Design Experience: Strong, hands-on experience in high-fidelity visual design, typography, color theory, and creating/maintaining design systems for web products.
  • Consumer Web Focus: Demonstrated ability to design and launch successful consumer-facing products on the web.
  • Portfolio: Mandatory submission of a portfolio (e.g., personal website, Dribbble, GitHub) that clearly demonstrates a focus on design thinking, user flows, and high-end aesthetic execution for consumer web applications.


Nice-to-haves:

  • AI/ML Design: Experience designing user experiences for AI/ML-powered features or familiarity with the principles of Agentic AI.
  • Familiarity with motion design and animation principles to enhance user interactions.
  • Proficiency with front-end code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript frameworks) to facilitate better collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in Design, HCI, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on Product Design (UX/UI) for consumer-facing web applications, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

description:
For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.


Job Purpose:

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Product Designer to own the end-to-end user experience for our Carnegie Audiences suite of products (careerexplorer.com and supplemental products), including the integration and design of new Agentic AI interactions. You will be responsible for translating complex user needs and business goals into intuitive, elegant, and effective design solutions. This role requires a strong focus on core user experience, user flows, and wireframing, in addition to high-quality visual user interface (UI) execution.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • User Experience (UX) Strategy and Design
  • Lead the design process from initial concept and user research through to final implementation and iteration, focusing on complex user flows, information architecture, and system design.
  • Develop and refine wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups to communicate design intent and test hypotheses with users and stakeholders.
  • Conduct usability testing, analyze user data, and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement of the product experience.
  • Design and integrate Agentic AI experiences into product flows, ensuring a seamless, trustworthy, and effective interaction between the user and the AI system.
  • User Interface (UI) Design and Visual Execution
  • Create polished, high-fidelity visual designs and detailed design specifications that adhere to brand guidelines and accessibility standards.
  • Maintain and contribute to our existing Design System, ensuring consistency, scalability, and efficiency across all product touchpoints.
  • Champion a high-end aesthetic in all product outputs, focusing on design principles that enhance clarity and drive user adoption.
  • Data Product Development
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to translate strategic requirements into data product features.
  • Direct the building and maintenance of data-centric applications and tools that leverage machine learning insights.
  • Implement and manage MLOps and CI/CD workflows for efficient model and data product deployments.
  • Ensure data governance, quality, and integrity across all analytical solutions.
  • Collaboration and Implementation
  • Partner closely with Product Managers to define product strategy and requirements, ensuring design solutions align with business objectives and technical constraints.
  • Collaborate with front-end engineers to ensure accurate design implementation and a seamless, high-quality user experience post-launch.
  • Participate in agile development processes, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and design critiques.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • UX/UI Acumen: Exceptional ability to translate strategic product goals into logical user flows and visually compelling, intuitive user interfaces, evidenced by a strong public portfolio of work on consumer-facing web products.
  • Technical Design Proficiency: Expertise in current design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) for creating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, and specifications.
  • Design Ownership and Initiative: Proven ability to manage a design portfolio autonomously, proactively identify design opportunities, and take ownership of the product’s end-to-end user experience.
  • Problem-Solving: Dexterity to effectively navigate complex design challenges and continuously seek elegant solutions that balance user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility.
  • Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively present design rationale to non-technical stakeholders and facilitate productive design critiques.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced spoken English level (B2–C1 or higher).


Requirements:

  • Advanced Proficiency in UX Design: Deep expertise in the full lifecycle of UX design, including user research, wireframing, journey mapping, and developing interactive prototypes that demonstrate complex user flows.
  • Expert UI/Visual Design Experience: Strong, hands-on experience in high-fidelity visual design, typography, color theory, and creating/maintaining design systems for web products.
  • Consumer Web Focus: Demonstrated ability to design and launch successful consumer-facing products on the web.
  • Portfolio: Mandatory submission of a portfolio (e.g., personal website, Dribbble, GitHub) that clearly demonstrates a focus on design thinking, user flows, and high-end aesthetic execution for consumer web applications.


Nice-to-haves:

  • AI/ML Design: Experience designing user experiences for AI/ML-powered features or familiarity with the principles of Agentic AI.
  • Familiarity with motion design and animation principles to enhance user interactions.
  • Proficiency with front-end code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript frameworks) to facilitate better collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Experience in the higher education or SaaS technology sectors.


Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent professional life/work experience in Design, HCI, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience in a role focused on Product Design (UX/UI) for consumer-facing web applications, preferably within a fast-paced technology or SaaS environment.


We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.
